description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet The Team**
 Dexcom is a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment where you work with leading\-edge, software teams to ensure the security of modern diabetes medical device systems. You will work alongside highly skilled and passionate cybersecurity professionals who know how to deliver exceptional results while also having some fun along the way. For this role, you would be joining Dexcom’s Research and Development Cybersecurity team to help design and implement new applications and features for Dexcom’s medical device platforms.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* You will be responsible for creating, updating, and managing the documents detailing the technical implementation of security and privacy requirements for internal and external development teams; internal and external auditors; and regulatory bodies or customers requiring disclosure of our practices.
* You manage coordination with Cyber architects, product owners, and other cross\-functional teams to ensure the completion of the documents.
* You will develop technical data\-flow diagrams in conjunction with peer technical writers and engineering leads to achieve a shared understanding of proposed architectural designs.
* You will be responsible for writing technical and non\-technical overview descriptions of components and services that provide stakeholders with a summary of system architecture and other program decisions.
* Ensure all deliverables maintain a simple, succinct content flow with correct grammar and spelling.
* You manage coordination with Cyber stakeholders, including development teams, to understand their documentation needs from our team and ensure the documentation is of an appropriate level of thoroughness.


**What Makes You Successful**
* You have solid proficiency in MS Word (including Styles and Template development), Excel, Visio and Lucid Chart
* You are a results\-oriented, self\-disciplined, fast\-paced, motivated individual that requires minimal supervision
* You are proactive and employ efficient research practices to quickly understand program complexity and escalate risks and roadblocks accurately
* You exhibit excellent project management skills to effectively organize and prioritize tasks among multiple projects
* You like to collaborate with various subject matter experts from Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Verification \& Validation, Document Control, and Program Management
* You demonstrate excellent attention to detail with a focus on quality, consistency, and accuracy
* You are familiar with SDLC and DDLC model, threat modeling, and risk assessments
* You possess the skill to handle pressure and meet multiple deadlines while prioritizing them. You can learn new processes quickly in a rapidly developing environment. Additionally, you have a strong analytical and technical aptitude, allowing you to understand complex processes and concepts.


**What You’ll Get**
* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community.
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
* An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


**Travel Required**
* 0\-5%


**Experience And Education Requirements**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 – 8 years of related experience


*To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.*
**AI in Hiring Notice:** 
 We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.
   

  

 At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.
   

  

 Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com.

**Responsibilities for External Candidates**
* Strong experience in developing enterprise web applications.
* Expertise on the Microsoft technology stack (ASP.NET MVC 3\.5 / 4\.0 / 4\.5, Web API, SQL Server).
* Good knowledge of Client side scripting â€“ JavaScript and JQuery, Kendo.

* Ability to communicate with technical experts as well as functional teams.

* Ability to propose solutions for design and architecture.
* Demonstrated experience in complex software troubleshooting techniques.
* Experience in Product Engineering is desirable.
* Exposure to Windows Azure is an added advantage.


**Responsibilities**
**Architecture \& System Design**
* Design scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems for enterprise applications
* Define architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices across modules
* Ensure system design aligns with performance, security, and scalability requirements


**Technical Leadership**
* Guide teams on architecture principles, coding standards, and design decisions

* Mentor engineers on system design and technical problem\-solving


**Modern Engineering (Added for current market)**
* Drive implementation of microservices and cloud\-native architectures
* Enable adoption of AI\-assisted development workflows (Copilot, prompt\-based design)
* Support integration of AI/ML components into application workflows


**Platform \& Performance**
* Identify and resolve system bottlenecks and architectural issues

**DevOps \& Cloud**

**Collaboration**

**Experience**

**Technical Skills**
* Strong expertise in .NET, C\#, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

**Modern Stack (Market aligned)**

+ Microservices \& event\-driven architectures

* Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI integration in applications


**Engineering Practices**
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automation
* Strong understanding of secure coding and reliability practices


**Soft Skills**
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Ability to influence design decisions and drive alignment
* Ownership mindset with focus on execution

description:
**Summary**
 Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only\-at\-Apple experience. At Apple, we believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.
   

  

 As a Genius, you combine extensive functional troubleshooting skills with an ability to inspire excitement for Apple’s products and services. You deliver exceptional service and empower customers to get the most out of their Apple products and services. A Genius makes sure customers are educated about repair options and Apple offerings, and performs repairs on all Apple products serviced in the store.
   

  

 A Genius excels in repairing relationships with customers and demonstrates the high standard of service and support in our retail stores. You enhance team knowledge by modelling exceptional service and educating and mentoring team members.
   

  

**Description**
 Have extensive knowledge and stay up to date on all Apple products, services and Genius Bar repair processes and procedures to support efficient and high\-quality repairs.
   

  

 Support customers having Apple product or software issues with care and empathy, using all tools and resources provided by Apple.
   

  

 Troubleshoot, diagnose, repair and resolve service concerns for Apple hardware and software.
   

  

 Provide excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting product and service recommendations, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy.
   

  

 Work with team leaders to identify recurring repair problems and other service concerns, and make sure that feedback is provided to Apple.
   

  

 Use extensive knowledge of hardware and software components to identify where technical concerns may originate from and educate others on the team.
   

  

 Serve as a Mentor, resource and positive role model for Genius Bar team members.
   

  

 Support leadership in providing timely resolution to customer escalations.
   

  

 Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to supporting customer\-facing activities on or off the sales floor.
   

  

 Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.
   

  

 Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* You should:
* Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
* Have experience in retail or sales, or related work experience.
* Have the ability to visually inspect hardware and the fine motor skills to safely conduct repairs.
* Have experience troubleshooting hardware and software issues in a customer service environment.
* Be proficient in the local language, both written and spoken.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* You can:
* Demonstrate technical expertise of Apple products and services, including repairing devices.
* Analyse problems and follow troubleshooting steps to identify the root cause of a technical issue.
* Navigate customer service issues with care and strong interpersonal skills.
* Apply an action\-oriented mindset and sense of motivation to do what’s best for the customer and Apple, often anticipating and adjusting for problems and roadblocks.
* Work in a fast\-paced environment, often under tight deadlines and pressure, while supporting multiple customers or hardware repairs at the same time.
* Communicate effectively and tailor your communication style to different audiences.
* Collaborate and motivate across the store and and among key partners to achieve individual and overall team goals.
* Support and educate the broader team by sharing knowledge, experiences and insights.
* Frequently handle, lift and move merchandise safely.


 At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
   

  

 Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**How will you make an impact?**


Join a team of digital content professionals dedicated to improving how scientists discover and engage with our products and solutions. As a **Scientific Digital Content Writer**, you will apply your scientific background and digital expertise to create clear, accurate, and high\-performing content that supports our customers across the buyer journey.


In this role, you will contribute to content strategy and execution by developing and optimizing web content using SEO and AI\-assisted methodologies. You will help ensure content is structured, discoverable, and aligned with user intent, while maintaining the highest standards of scientific accuracy and quality.


You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners, incorporate subject matter expertise, and use performance insights to continuously improve content effectiveness. This role requires a proactive, detail\-oriented individual who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and is motivated to learn and apply new tools and processes that drive efficiency and scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct keyword, topic, and intent research to identify opportunities to drive qualified traffic and engagement
* Develop, write, edit, and optimize scientific and marketing content for web and digital channels
* Apply SEO and AEO best practices to improve content discoverability and performance
* Evaluate existing content to identify duplication, gaps, and optimization opportunities; recommend and implement improvements
* Structure content using clear hierarchies, taxonomy, and internal linking to enhance user experience
* Participate in peer reviews and provide constructive feedback to support content quality and consistency
* Partner with SEO specialists, marketers, and digital teams to support aligned content strategies and initiatives
* Analyze content performance using analytics tools and apply insights to improve results
* Support the adoption of new content workflows, tools, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
* Perform additional duties as assigned

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in biology or related life sciences field required
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) preferred

**Experience**

* Experience in a life sciences field (e.g., research, R\&D, marketing, technical support, or related)
* Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills
* Experience writing scientific, technical, or marketing content for digital platforms preferred
* Experience working in a matrixed or global organization preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated understanding of SEO and emerging AEO principles, with the ability to apply best practices
* Experience using analytics and SEO tools (e.g., Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, SEMrush or similar)
* Knowledge of content strategy fundamentals, including information architecture, taxonomy, and user experience
* Comfort using AI\-enabled tools to enhance content creation, optimization, and workflow efficiency (no development required)
* Ability to evaluate and refine AI\-assisted outputs to ensure scientific accuracy and content quality
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with attention to detail
* Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross\-functional teams
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

**Our Mission**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global Component Content Management System (CCMS) and expertise partner. We specialize in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 We are headquartered in Annapolis, Maryland, and have U.S. offices in North Carolina and Wisconsin, with additional staff located around the country, including Contiem employees working full\-time at some of our clients’ facilities. Outside the U.S., our offices are located in India, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are a global company, serving organizations of all sizes, including many of the largest brands in the world. Our customers include leading brands in Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a skilled and versatile
 **Senior Technical Illustrator** 
 with a proven track record of delivering high\-quality illustrations across diverse projects for multiple clients, with varying standards and expectations. This client\-facing role could involve rotating assignments and supporting multiple organizations. The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments and proactively applies their expertise to learn and adapt to evolving client needs.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
 The ideal candidate will have:
   

  

* A strong technical illustration background, developing a variety of graphic types to support operation, maintenance, repair, and user/installation manuals for a wide variety of industrial and consumer products.
* Experience creating product illustrations, working with mechanical/engineering drawings, and modifying existing graphics.
* Considerable experience with tools such as SolidWorks Composer, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Acrobat
* Previous experience working with layout and graphic design is a plus
* Previous experience in animation is highly desired.


**Experience And Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Illustration, or a related field.
* 10 \+ years of experience in technical illustration.
* 2\+ years of experience using (all) the following applications: SolidWorks Composer, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Acrobat Professional.
* Experience developing a variety of illustrations for different types of documentation.
* Ability to interpret product information and convey it within an illustration to provide clear, concise instruction or the end user.
* Animation experience.
* Experience working in a client\-facing capacity.
* Excellent interpersonal and general business communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as a part of a team.
* Organized and attention to detail.
* Proven success working and prioritizing in an environment that is driven by budget, scope, and deadlines across multiple clients/projects.
* Proven success interacting with multiple clients, subject matter experts, and project managers.


 Please note, this job description does not cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

Title: Associate Content Researcher
   

  

**Location:** 
 Vashi, Navi Mumbai
   

  

 Morningstar is a leading provider of independent investment research in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. We offer a wide variety of products and solutions that serve market participants of all kinds, including individual and institutional investors in public and private capital markets, financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers and sponsors, and issuers of securities.
   

  

 Morningstar India has been a Great Place to Work\-certified company for the past ten consecutive years.
   

  

**The Team**
 As an essential part of Morningstar Global MID Organization,
 **Data Content Research** 
 Team is responsible for data process solution analysis and impact analysis for new data or data changes, business rule management, and data collection platform change request review and sign off. The team would collaborate with different data function teams on key data initiatives, and continue drive operation excellence.
   

  

**The Role**
 Morningstar seeks a self\-motivated
 **Associate** 
**Data Content Researcher** 
 to join Mumbai Managed Investment Data team. In this role, you will work with Data Strategy team, Tech team and Global MID operations team to implement new data, data changes, business rule enhancement and interface enhancements to drive operation excellence. You will be a key contributor to design new data collection process flow and user interface, build creative tool and provide insight for data enhancement and you would also play a key role as the data escalation point. Your exposure to global teams will allow you to have a solid foundation for your career. This position is based in Mumbai office.
   

  

**Shift \-** 
 UK
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* 
+ Review and interpret business requirements to propose actionable data and process solutions
+ Use data mining to surface data issue and support data strategy decision\-making.
+ Design new data flow and user interface, build back\-end logic to ensure data accuracy.
+ Provide solution and consultation for data processing improvement from overall data perspective.
+ Provide proper proposal for data quality control backend logic to drive data accuracy improvement.
+ Interpret data methodologies into usable technology language through detailed written specifications
+ Conduct feasibility analysis and impact analysis to evaluate data solution / methodology feasibility and impact
+ Communicate with stakeholders on the potential impacts or risks of the proposal, and make the risk mitigation plan
+ Coordinates with relevant teams to ensure proper implementation and documentation
+ Maintain database backend knowledge and build readable documentation.


**Requirements**
* 
+ 3\-6 years in business/data analysis, preferably within capital markets, wealth management, or asset management domains.
+ A bachelor’s degree in engineering, finance, economics, or business with an exceptional academic record.
+ Understanding of Database Structure and Design
+ Experience with SQL. Basic programming, Python and database skills is preferred
+ Experience with AI tools is a plus
+ Strong quantitative and business analysis skills
+ Excellent English verbal/presentation/written communication skills
+ Highly interest in data and analytics
+ Profound understanding of Fund data
+ Data, system, process and backend logic
+ Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and organized
+ CFA/NISM/FRM/NCFM certifications or progress towards those preferred.


**Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.**
 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.
   

  

 Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
   

  

 Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
   

  

 The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Medical Documentation Specialist (MDS) is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and comprehensive clinical documentation that supports healthcare professionals in providing high\-quality patient care. Working as an extension of healthcare professionals, the MDS documents patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems while ensuring compliance with organizational quality standards, provider preferences, and applicable healthcare regulations.
   

  

 Medical Documentation Specialists leverage Commure's Ambient AI technology and documentation workflows to reduce providers' administrative burden, enabling providers to spend more time focusing on patient care.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level opportunity designed for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. Through a structured onboarding program, comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, and continuous feedback, Medical Documentation Specialists develop expertise in clinical documentation, medical terminology, healthcare technology, provider workflows, and documentation best practices while maintaining the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Training \& Development
   

  

 Every Medical Documentation Specialist begins their journey with Commure's structured Training and Development Program, designed specifically for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. The program provides a strong foundation through a combination of instructor\-led learning, hands\-on practice, real\-world simulations, regular assessments, continuous coaching, and personalized feedback, enabling participants to build the knowledge, skills, and confidence required to succeed in the role.
   

  

 The program is designed to prepare participants for live documentation responsibilities while fostering professional growth, operational excellence, and a commitment to continuous learning. Upon successful completion of the training program, participants transition into the Medical Documentation Specialist role with ongoing coaching, mentorship, and quality support to further develop their expertise and advance their careers within Commure.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

**The Medical Documentation Specialist Is Accountable For**
* Delivering accurate, complete, and timely clinical documentation that reflects healthcare professionals' intent.
* Supporting providers by reducing documentation burden and improving workflow efficiency.
* Maintaining high standards of documentation quality, compliance, and confidentiality.
* Learning and applying clinician\-specific documentation preferences, specialty workflows, and documentation standards through structured training.
* Continuously building knowledge and proficiency while contributing to operational excellence within Ambient Operations.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Clinical Documentation**
* Accurately document patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Capture patient history, review of systems, physical examination findings, assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, procedures, medications, and other clinically relevant information.
* Ensure documentation accurately reflects the clinician's observations, clinical assessments, and medical decision\-making.
* Review completed documentation for completeness, consistency, and accuracy prior to submission.
* Complete documentation within established turnaround time and productivity expectations.
* Apply learnings from onboarding, coaching sessions, and quality feedback to continuously improve documentation accuracy and efficiency.


**Clinician Support**
* Provide documentation support for clinicians across multiple specialties including, but not limited to:
+ Primary Care
+ Internal Medicine
+ Oncology
+ Orthopedics
+ Rheumatology
+ Other specialties as assigned.

* Learn clinician\-specific workflows, documentation preferences, and specialty requirements through structured training and practical experience.
* Adapt documentation style and workflow to individual clinician requirements.
* Communicate professionally and effectively while supporting providers and collaborating with internal stakeholders.


**Documentation Quality**
* Produce documentation that meets established organizational quality standards and clinician expectations.
* Learn and apply specialty/provider\-specific documentation guidelines and best practices.
* Identify documentation inconsistencies and seek clarification through appropriate channels when required.
* Incorporate feedback from quality reviews, coaching sessions, and audits into daily practice.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and calibration activities.


**Technology \& Workflow Management**
* Utilize Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and documentation platforms effectively.
* Develop proficiency in Commure's Ambient AI documentation technology and associated workflow tools through structured training and guided practice.
* Navigate multiple systems while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and quality.
* Follow established operational workflows, standard operating procedures, and documentation processes.
* Escalate workflow, technology, or system\-related issues through appropriate channels.


**Compliance \& Information Security**
* Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements.
* Protect Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with organizational policies.
* Adhere to Commure's compliance, security, and documentation standards.
* Complete mandatory compliance and security training within required timelines.


**Continuous Learning \& Professional Development**
* Successfully complete onboarding, certification, and ongoing training programs.
* Continuously develop knowledge of medical terminology, specialty\-specific documentation, healthcare workflows, and emerging technologies.
* Stay current with documentation standards, organizational processes, and workflow enhancements.
* Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
* Actively participate in refresher trainings, coaching sessions, quality reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


**Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with Operations, Quality, Training, Product, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Participate in coaching sessions, quality calibrations, workflow reviews, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and quality teams to continuously improve performance.
* Escalate documentation, workflow, clinician, or operational concerns through appropriate channels.
* Support initiatives that improve documentation quality, clinician satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

**commure.com** 
 . Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.
   

  

 Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

description:
Job Description
**About ClearTax**

We are the architects of the modern financial operating system. Since our inception in 2011, ClearTax has transformed from a disruptive tax\-filing startup into India’s leading B2B tax compliance and finance powerhouse. Today, we empower the CFO’s office by providing an integrated, AI\-driven ecosystem that handles everything from GST and e\-invoicing to accounts payable and wealth management.


The Impact of Our Work: We operate at a scale that defines the digital economy. As a Series C\-funded leader backed by Y Combinator, Sequoia Capital, and Stripe, we:


* Power Global Trade: We process nearly 10% of India’s B2B invoices, representing over $300 billion in annual trade value.


* Drive Real Savings: In the last year, our automation tools returned over ₹1,000 crore to the bottom lines of our customers through intelligent insights.


* Scale Globally: We provide assured compliance for enterprises across 50\+ countries, spanning the EMEA and APAC regions, including the UAE and the EU.


**The Role**

This is a create\-and\-distribute role. You'll take complex global tax and compliance mandates: e\-invoicing rollouts, regulatory deadlines, new digital reporting regimes, and package them into content that enterprise decision\-makers actually read, share, and act on. Then you'll own that content in front of them.


You're not just a writer, and you're not just a channel operator. You're both: someone who can produce a survey report on Monday and architect its distribution across email, social, webinars, and events by Friday. You think in funnels, not just formats! Every asset you create has a job to do in moving prospects from first touch to sales\-accepted lead.


This is a high\-ownership role on a team that ships fast and experiments constantly, with AI as a core part of how we work.


**Outcomes \& Responsibilities**

AI is changing how customers find brands, and Yext gives enterprises the infrastructure to compete: Scout analyzes 10 billion signals monthly across four AI models to surface where you're losing and why, the Knowledge Graph maintains the verified data AI cites, and content generation and distribution agents syndicate brand content across LLMs, listings, social platforms, and review sites in real time. Join us and experience firsthand why we are consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work globally by Built In, Fortune, and Great Place To Work®.
   

  

 Yext is seeking an experienced and business\-focused Billing and Revenue Systems Manager to support our core subscription management platforms. Reporting to the Director of Billing and Revenue Systems, this role focuses heavily on functional expertise, business process design, and the optimization of our Order\-to\-Cash lifecycle. You will serve as a key functional leader for the Zuora Billing platform, translating complex accounting and commercial business cases into scalable system configurations. The ideal candidate blends deep, practical knowledge of SaaS billing workflows with strong stakeholder and project management capabilities to bridge the gap between financial requirements and technical execution.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Functional Platform Ownership: Serve as a key internal administrator and functional lead for the Zuora Billing and Revenue platform, ensuring high performance, proper customization, and alignment with industry best practices.
* Solution Architecture \& Design: Design and architect subscription billing solutions, configuring business rules, advanced workflows, and pricing models within Zuora to meet evolving company requirements.
* Business Requirement Translation: Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, and Revenue teams to gather, document, and analyze complex requirements related to automated billing and revenue management.
* System Connectivity \& Logic: Bridge business processes with technical teams, translating enterprise business cases into actionable configuration changes and technical solutions utilizing Zuora's API capabilities.
* Data Integration Support: Collaborate with technical teams to optimize and maintain automated data synchronization and workflows between Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, Salesforce, and General Ledger platforms.
* Operational Excellence: Proactively monitor platform health, troubleshoot functional billing issues, and spearhead the implementation of system updates and patch enhancements.
* Continuous Improvement: Actively evaluate the latest Zuora platform features and industry trends to continuously optimize system performance and automate manual accounting workstreams.


**What You Have**
* 7\+ years of experience in subscription management and financial systems, with a strong track record of hands\-on platform implementation and team leadership.
* Zuora Functional Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Zuora Billing (required) and Zuora Revenue (RevPro) architecture.
* Order\-to\-Cash Proficiency: Strong analytical understanding of SaaS workflows, including quoting, invoicing, complex subscription models, and revenue recognition.
* Tech Stack Familiarity: Hands\-on experience navigating interconnected ecosystems including Salesforce and Enterprise General Ledger systems like NetSuite.
* Technical Literacy: Solid foundation understanding XML/JSON or scripting languages (like Python) to effectively collaborate with IT developer resources on API integrations.
* Adaptability \& Leadership: Demonstrated capability to lead projects through ambiguous situations, manage shifting priorities, and seamlessly adopt new financial technologies.
* Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate accounting needs into clear functional specifications.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems (MIS), IT, or an equivalent field.

**Here’s a summary of the role:**

* Investigate application errors and determine when an issue should be treated as a product bug and escalated to the appropriate Tier 2 or product team.
* Build strong customer relationships by explaining technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.

description:

 Chennai, India

 Research \& Development

 Regular, Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Team Manager for Technical Writing at Epiroc, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality technical documentation that supports the safe operation and maintenance of our advanced mining, earthmoving, and drilling equipment. Your leadership will be instrumental in driving the development of instruction manuals and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that are precise, user\-friendly, and aligned with product requirements.
   

  

 You will collaborate cross\-functionally with project offices, R\&D, and service operations teams to gather, refine, and incorporate critical product information. Using advanced Content Management Systems and Technical Information platforms, you will ensure the efficient publishing and timely communication of technical documents to our customers and stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical manuals and SOPs for a broad range of equipment including drill rigs, loaders, and trucks, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with engineering standards.

* Manage and optimize the use of content management systems and technology tools like Adobe InDesign, XMetaL, Oxygen, Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 to enable modular content creation and single\-sourcing for maximum reuse and consistency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to innovate technical communication methods, reduce translation costs, simplify content complexity, and enhance overall documentation quality and customer experience.

* Recruit, develop, and retain a skilled technical writing team by nurturing a motivated, collaborative, and high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and performance evaluations, fostering professional growth aligned with evolving business and technology trends.
* Define, implement, and refine internal standards, workflows, and best practices to enhance operational efficiency and deliverables quality.
* Monitor team performance through metrics and reporting tools, ensuring objectives related to quality, delivery timelines, and resource management are met consistently.
* Promote Epiroc’s core values including integrity, inclusivity, and open communication within your team and broader corporate community.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum of 12 years of industrial experience specifically within mining, earthmoving, drilling equipment, or off\-road vehicle sectors.
* Extensive experience in structured authoring, modular content development, and enterprise\-level Content Management Systems delivering single\-source publishing solutions.
* Proven expertise in technical documentation methodologies including topic\-based authoring, minimalism in communication, DITA standards, and XML authoring tools such as XMetaL or Oxygen.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English to ensure clarity and global usability of documentation.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign), Teamcenter, and Schema ST4 for document management and production.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to translate complex technical and customer requirements into clear, actionable tasks.
* Demonstrated effective communication and leadership capabilities with experience managing multi\-disciplinary teams in dynamic, results\-driven environments.


**Desired Behaviors and Competencies**
* Highly enthusiastic and responsible with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to excel in a fast\-paced, pressure\-driven environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to foster collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills combined with a goal\-oriented and self\-motivated mindset.
* Adaptable, open\-minded, and receptive to new ideas, technologies, and working methods.
* Committed to continuous learning and professional development for oneself and the team.


**Why Join Us?**
 This role offers a unique opportunity to take full ownership of the technical documentation lifecycle within a leading company in the mining industry. You will lead a talented team and be empowered to innovate documentation processes and technologies, contributing directly to product safety, usability, and customer satisfaction. Epiroc fosters an inclusive, values\-driven culture where integrity, collaboration, and respect are paramount. Additionally, this position provides substantial opportunities for professional growth and skill enhancement aligned with industry advancements.
   

  

**About Epiroc**
 Epiroc is a global leader in mining and infrastructure equipment, dedicated to sustainable productivity and innovation. Our commitment to safety, ethics, and diversity creates a dynamic workplace where employees thrive and contribute to impactful projects that shape the future of mining technologies.
   

  

 Join us and be part of a culture that values your unique talents and supports your career journey.
   

  

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.
   

  

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World\-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two\-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth


 The Senior Associate, Federal Grants will work directly with Ryan team members and Ryan clients/companies to support the development of government funding applications and proposals by playing a key role in researching requirements and writing and editing application and proposal content as a member of a grant writing team. They may also support Ryan in post\-award compliance activities and provide other grant\-related support requested by clients. In addition, the Senior Associate will lead research on U.S. government grants, loans, and contracts and related legislation to ensure the firm's grants knowledge is continually updated. The position will demand high attention to detail and the ability to multi\-task in constantly changing environments. The position requires strong writing, critical thinking, decision\-making, and analysis skills as well as an ability to comprehend and synthesize complex concepts and communicate clearly with stakeholders. The position requires the ability to effectively use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance workflow efficiency while exercising independent judgment and critical thinking when evaluating information and making decisions.
   

  

 The position involves significant project management skills to research and support the development and writing of grant and loan applications and contract proposals that are anticipated to range from $100,000 to $100,000,000\+ in size. These funding applications are positioned to assist our clients’ businesses with their unique projects and could cover a wide array of industries included, but not limited to: energy, agriculture, health, manufacturing, industry, education, and research and development.
   

  

**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**
* Overall Team Support: Our team works together to support multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. The Senior Associate will be communicating, collaborating, and working directly with Ryan Managers and Consultants and third party stakeholders.
* Project Management: This role involves leading and writing multiple, concurrent projects and managing them effectively to ensure the final products meet internal and client standards.
* Administrative Duties: Recordkeeping and reporting to senior management, including use of Ryan’s internal file and client management systems.
* Internal Meetings: Meeting preparation and facilitation for internal weekly Grant team meetings. (The primary Grants team members are currently located in Washington, DC on Eastern Time so the Senior Associate shall assume that the weekly meetings, and any client support meetings, will occur in line with Eastern Time zone.)
* Other: The Senior Associate will be called on to support special projects, high\-priority items, new/existing funding program research, review of existing materials, and updates and enhancements to team products and marketing materials, etc.


**Client**
* Funding Strategizing and Project Scoping: The Senior Associate will be responsible for researching specific funding opportunities for Ryan clients and as such will need to develop a strong understanding of our clients’ projects and areas of investment. The Senior Associate will gather/synthesize project information, identify possible grants and funding opportunities of potential relevance, and prepare reports and materials to summarize the scoped opportunities for review by Ryan staff and ultimate presentation and sharing with clients.
* Information Gathering and Analysis: Support client engagements, company and project information gathering, project scoping and strategizing, and communicating program and project details to Ryan staff and clients, if/as requested.
* Client Relationship Management: The Senior Associate may be invited to client meetings and as such will be required to manage client requests and expectations effectively. They will develop strong working relationships with Ryan staff and clients to ensure project completion and successful submission of requested deliverables.


**Value**
* Conduct Ongoing Grants Research (30%): Support with ongoing grant program research to ensure the Firm’s knowledge is up to date. This involves researching through a variety of online sources, including current U.S. Federal appropriation and legislative materials, reviewing client data and publicly available reports and information on grant and funding vehicles.
* Support Application and Proposal Research, Preparation, Writing, and Reviewing (30%): Either on their own or with a Ryan team member, work on the preparation and submission of funding applications and proposals for clients. This includes synthesizing project information gathered from research, client meetings, notes from the sales team or Manager, and previous funding proposals. They will evaluate and interpret quantitative and qualitative information from credible sources; identify supporting evidence and trends, and incorporate properly cited data into applications. The Senior Consultant will be asked to develop narrative content, budget materials, and graphically rich appendices and executive summary materials. An Engagement Manager, Director, or Senior Consultant will review work and provide feedback for changes or improvement before submitting.
* Support Systemization and Document Management (20%): As documentation for a project comes in, the Senior Associate will be responsible for filing and storing the documents appropriately on our system and ensuring they can be located for later use. The Senior Associate is responsible for maintaining the integrity and consistency of our file management system. The Senior Associate may be asked to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Provide Sales and Marketing Support (20%): The Senior Associate will support, and sometimes lead, the development of marketing materials and sales tools and other thought leadership documentation to assist in the marketing and sales process for the U.S. federal grants sub\-practice.


**Education And Experience**
 A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business/Administration, English or Communications/Journalism, or a related discipline is required. Prior experience in Grants, familiarity with U.S. government programs, and broad business experience and business plan writing would be strong assets.
   

  

**Qualifications Required**
* 2\-3 years of experience in industry with progressive responsibility
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM
* Excellent writing skills and experience presenting written submissions C level executives
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* High comfort level working independently and in a team environment
* Strong decision\-making skills: ability to work with limited information
* Strong research skills
* Ability to work confidently under pressure with tight timelines
* Experience working in a client facing role
* English fluency, both oral and written


**Qualifications Preferred**
* Experience writing grant or contract proposal narratives
* Expertise leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support research and content development
* Experience reporting to, or working with, clients and business leaders
* Strong ability to manage client expectations
* Industry experience in roles that include strategic planning, project management, or similar
* Demonstrated editorial, graphic design, or marketing skills


**Computer Skills**
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft® Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Internet navigation and research. Experience with generative AI tools is also preferred.
   

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

* Has successfully managed quality during multiple international and/or cross\- functional IT projects and/or operations and has a minimum of 3 years hands\-on quality management.
* Expert Knowledge and hands\-on working experience of Quality and Security Management in the following areas / disciplines GxP, CSV and GAMP·

description:
Job Title: Founder’s Office Intern (Remote) \| The "Shadow CEO" Program
 



  





 Location: Remote (India)
 



 Type: Internship 6 months
 



 Stipend: Unpaid (Performance\-based perks \& High\-Value Mentorship)
 



  





 This is not a normal internship.
 



  





 If you are looking for a 9\-to\-5 where you are told exactly what to do every hour, do not apply. If you are looking for easy pocket money, do not apply.
 



 This is a Founder’s Office role at Focus Realm. You will work directly with the Founder (Sehej Sharma) as a "Shadow CEO."
 



  





 The Mission (What You Will Do)
 



 Since this is a remote role, your output is your currency. You will handle three core pillars:
 



 1\. Strategic Operations (The "Chief of Staff" Work):
 


* Meeting Shadowing: Sit in on high\-stakes Zoom calls with CXOs and Directors. Take minutes, decode the negotiation psychology, and draft follow\-up emails.
* Workflow Automation: You will not do manual data entry twice. You will use AI (ChatGPT/Perplexity), Zapier, and Notion to build systems that automate the boring stuff.
* Inbox \& Calendar Command: You will act as the gatekeeper, prioritizing the Founder's time and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.



 2\. Growth \& Research (The "Builder" Work):
 


* Market Intelligence: Deep dive into Tier\-3 Education markets or Hospitality trends to find our next 10 clients.
* Pitch Deck Architecture: Assist in crafting high\-impact presentations for investors and partners.
* LinkedIn Brand Building: Help draft content, engage with partners, and manage the company’s digital footprint.



 3\. Execution (The "Hustle"):
 


* Running cold outreach campaigns.
* Coordinating with tech teams to ensure product delivery timelines are met.



  





 How You Will Perform (The Expectations)
 



 Because this is Remote, we value Discipline over "Hours Logged."
 


* High Agency: You don't wait for instructions. If you see a broken link, you fix it. If you see a missing lead, you find it.
* Async Communication: You communicate clearly on Slack/WhatsApp. No "Hi" messages. You send the update, the context, and the solution in one go.
* Tech\-Native: You are faster on Notion, Canva, and Google Sheets than anyone you know.
* Thick Skinned: You want honest feedback. You iterate fast. You don't take critiques personally.



  




* The Deal (Terms \& Conditions)Duration: This is a Locked\-in 3\-Month Commitment. We invest heavy time in training you; we expect you to stick around.
* *Extension:* 
 Mutual agreement for another 3 months based on performance.
* Location: 100% Remote.
* Compensation: This is an UNPAID learning opportunity.
* *The Upside:* 
 You get a masterclass in entrepreneurship, direct access to a high\-level network, and a personalized, high\-impact Letter of Recommendation that opens doors.



  




* Who Should Apply?Aspiring Founders or Future CEOs.
* MBA students looking for real\-world application.
* Undergrads who are bored by their syllabus and want to build something real.

description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

This position typically refers to any employee within the EPD Medical organization with medical/scientific qualifications and training who provides scientific/medical support to EPD in a non\-sales capacity, where the provision of such scientific/medical support includes significant contact with Abbott customers in the field. This definition is not intended to apply to those employees whose primary job function relates to the monitoring or management of clinical studies.
   

  

 Reporting into the Senior Manager RMA / Head RMA this position participates in the initiation, oversight and follow\-up of assigned clinical studies and medical projects initiated within the EPD Medical Organization, ensuring that activities are carried out in accordance with relevant processes and procedures. The RMA interfaces with other key members of the EPD Medical Organization \- for example, Medical Managers, Clinical Research Managers and Medical Advisors \- relevant to the therapeutic area for which the RMA has responsibility. The RMA assists relationships and advances the scientific credibility of the Company with established and emerging Regional/National Opinion leaders, responds to requests for scientific and medical information, and provides key scientific information updates to Regional and National Opinion leaders, as appropriate. The RMA develops, and maintains, key scientific knowledge that will enable credible dissemination of scientific information and informed scientific dialogue with physicians and opinion leaders, and the development of professional working relationships.
   

  

 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES :
   

  

* Ensure that all activities and interactions are conducted with due regard to all applicable local, global and national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, Company policies and accepted standards of best practice.
* Provide scientific and technical support for, and help maintain professional and credible relationships with, key opinion leaders and academic centers to ensure access to current medical and scientific information on the products and areas of therapeutic interest.
* Ideate, design, develop and deliver innovative and engaging high science activities for Physicians and Key Opinion Leaders, to help drive Therapy Shaping in the area the RMA is assigned to, in collaboration with the Medical Affairs \& the Commercial team.
* Assist in the initiation, oversight and follow up of assigned clinical studies and medical projects initiated within the relevant therapeutic area for which the RMA carries responsibility (e.g. post marketing clinical activities such as registry/database projects, epidemiological surveys, post\-authorization studies (phase IV), IIS projects, etc.) : all activities to comply with applicable local laws, guidelines, codes of practice, SOPs, and , I\& D \* SOPs.
* Deliver high science, unbiased and accurate scientific presentations to physicians, individually or in groups (meetings, clinical sessions, etc.), when requested.
* Participate in the selection process to identify appropriately qualified physicians the Company would wish to engage in collaborative efforts – such as potential research collaborations, or lecture/meeting support (Round Tables, Congresses, Symposia, etc.); and to ensure a high level of scientific or educational integrity in these collaborative efforts.


 TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES :
   

  

* Therapeutic Area Expertise
* Management Skills
* Communication Skills
* Compliance \& Process Improvement Skills
* Problem/Conflict Solving Ability
* Priority Setting
* Relationship Building


 KEY INTERFACES :
   

  

* EPD medical personnel : Clinical Research Managers, Clinical Operations Managers, Medical Advisors; Medical Information team / specialists; EPD Pharmacovigilance / drug safety personnel
* Marketing department across therapeutic area
* Sales organization of the geographic area of responsibility.
* Administrative personnel of the Medical Department and of the Business Unit.
* Healthcare personnel (including; physicians, nurses, pharmacists).
* Patients (through Patient Awareness Programs)
* Participating Research Investigators
* Key Opinion leaders
* Institutions and Scientific or Medical Societies

 Data Analysis \& Insights

 Do you want to define the future of Internet commerce?

 Can you work at the scale of the biggest Internet companies?
   

  

 The solutions that you will deploy must scale to serve missions of customers worldwide, process thousands of transactions per minute and have an uptime greater than 99\.99%.
   

  

 Do you believe systems can always be made faster?
   

  

 If so, come be a member of Amazon’s Core Transportation Technology team. We build software systems that ensure millions of packages reach our customers in the fastest possible time. The systems you build will be at the forefront of our goal to ensure we are able to deliver packages same day or even within hours.
   

  

 Are you pedantic about code quality ?
   

  

 If so, we are looking for an individual like you to join a team of world class developers and help us write highest quality code which is readable, maintainable and can give our customers a bug free experience.
   

  

 Amazon is a premier place to build and deploy world class software
   

  

 Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995\. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service.
   

  

 Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. There are a variety of ways in which we acquire items from vendors to our warehouses, ship items from one location to another, and several intermediate locations through which the package travels before reaching the customer. There are millions of such packages, each with different attributes, and different delivery requirements. What results is a highly dense graph of source, intermediate and destination nodes, with arcs between them representing possible paths for packages, with different costs and times along each arc. Accounting for all these constraints, and maximizing the number of shipments shipped, while minimizing cost, providing a variety of delivery options and maximizing delivery performance is Transportation Engineering's primary focus.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a highly agile and self driven team of talented and motivated engineers based out of Delhi. We are at the heart of Amazon transportation and are responsible for managing entire package lifecycle. Team owns the orchestration of transportation requests, state management, proactive deviation management at network level, progress tracker operations like delivery to locker, cancel and notification of transportation events to downstream clients. Come join the team that sets a high bar for software development and operational excellence practices. We use Amazon wide tools and processes to a large extent, and we also contribute to the Amazon wide arsenal of tools that all businesses use to be more effective. We are early adopters of new tools and technologies, before they become mandatory.

 The primary focus of this role will be
 **YouTube scriptwriting** 
 , along with writing copy for email campaigns, LinkedIn, website pages, and other marketing channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter, you will be responsible for turning ideas, research, customer problems, and industry insights into compelling content.
 



  





 You will create YouTube scripts that capture attention, maintain curiosity, and communicate ideas clearly, while also developing marketing copy that connects with our target audience and drives action.

**Copywriting** 




  




* Write email campaigns, sequences, and newsletters.

* Create marketing copy around customer pain points, use cases, and product benefits.

**Research \& Audience Understanding** 




  




* Understand our target audience, including marketing agencies, marketers, and business owners.
* Research customer pain points, challenges, objections, and motivations.
* Understand what makes a prospect pay attention, engage, and take action.
* Translate customer and market insights into better content and messaging.
* Stay updated on trends in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing, agencies, and content.

* Strong written and spoken English.

**What We're Looking For**

 .

title: Executive Food Safety Management System Documentation And Compliance
description:
Sunshine Vegetables is hiring an Executive — FSMS, Documentation \& Compliance for the IQF plant at Sikandrabad, Bulandshahr.
 



  





 We hold FSSC 22000 and FSSAI certification. Keeping a certificate is not a project with an end date — it is a daily discipline of record integrity, and it is where most certified plants quietly slip. A document at the wrong revision on the line, a monitoring record signed in arrears, an internal audit that ran late: none of it shows until an auditor pulls the file.
 



  





 This role exists so that never happens here. It is deliberately separate from the Head of Quality, because one person cannot maintain the document set and clear product for dispatch on the same day.
 



  





 What the role owns:
 



  





 \- Document control. Current revisions in use at the point of work, obsolete copies withdrawn, change history intact
 



 \- The record architecture — monitoring records, verification records, retention schedules — complete, legible and retrievable on demand
 



 \- Traceability and mock recall. Trace a batch from a named contract farmer's field to a dispatched carton within four hours, and prove it twice a year
 



 \- The internal audit programme on schedule, and the CAPA register closed to timeline rather than closed on paper
 



 \- Management review, HACCP annual review, and surveillance audit readiness maintained continuously, not assembled the week before
 



 \- Regulatory and customer compliance — FSSAI Schedule 4 Part II, labelling and legal metrology, buyer questionnaires and specification files
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  





 \- 5–10 years in food manufacturing QA, degree in Food Technology or Microbiology
 



 \- You have maintained a certified FSMS through at least one surveillance audit cycle, hands\-on with the documentation
 



 \- Certified internal auditor against FSSC 22000 or an equivalent scheme
 



 \- You write clearly in English and you are exacting about detail. Half this job is writing; the other half is noticing
 



  





 What will make you stand out:
 



  





 \- Experience extending a certified scope over a new line
 



 \- Frozen, chilled or fresh vegetable processing
 



 \- Export documentation for EU or Gulf buyers, or customer audit handling for a QSR or retail account
 



  





 Compensation as per experience. On\-site at Sikandrabad; relocation support available.
 



  





 CV to sagardeswal@sunshinevegetables.com or WhatsApp \+91 80779 24395\.

**Responsibilities** 




 • Read PRDs and engineering specs, and translate them into clear technical documentation — user guides, release notes, API docs, internal runbooks

 • Maintain and improve those automations over time as our product and doc formats evolve
 



 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs

title: Content Lead- Discovery
description:
You will be the editor of a machine that writes for local businesses. You will not write the content. You will decide what good means, prove whether the machine is meeting it, and find the reasons when it is not.
   

  

**About Zoca**
 Zoca builds AI agents that local service businesses hire to run the parts of the business the owner cannot get to. More than 1,000 businesses use Zoca today. We started in beauty and wellness and are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital and GTM Fund.
   

  

 Discovery is the agent that runs a business’s online presence: its Google Business Profile, website, service pages, blogs, Google posts and reviews. It publishes on behalf of thousands of businesses every week, many of them in the same cities.
   

  

**The terrain**
 How does content written by a machine, for a business the machine only knows through data, become genuinely useful to a person searching nearby? How does it rank, and keep ranking, when the same machine is writing for the business down the street? Nobody at Zoca owns that question today. Engineers own the pipeline. Nobody owns what comes out of it.
   

  

 You would inherit a working pipeline from keywords to topics to published pages and posts, a per\-business context layer we call Brain that holds services, staff, tone and house rules, a live connection to every business’s Google Business Profile and Search Console, every review those businesses have received, and engineers who want someone to argue with about what the pipeline should produce. Over a thousand live businesses across many cities means a natural experiment running every day, if someone reads it.
   

  

**What We Know So Far**
 Google treats content produced at volume to manipulate ranking as spam, whoever wrote it. Fluent, generic content has become free, and specific, local, useful content has not. Many businesses in the same city want the same topics. And from the outside, a page that never got indexed, a page on the wrong topic, and a badly written page all look the same.
   

  

 What we do not know, and have opinions on that we will share after we hear yours: what separates two businesses’ content in the same zip code beyond the facts about each. How much business\-specific data moves ranking compared to the prose. Which content types are worth producing at all. Where a human belongs in the loop and where a human is a bottleneck dressed up as quality. And how you know a page is good before Google tells you two months later.
   

  

**What You Would Own**
* The definition of good. A rubric a person and a model can both apply, with pages that pass, pages that fail, and why.
* The weekly read. A sample of what shipped, across cities and business types, scored against the rubric, with every failure turned into a named class rather than a one\-off fix.
* The eval set. The pages the pipeline is measured against before anything goes live, and the automated judge engineering builds from it.
* Local intent, per business type. What someone searching for a lash studio wants to read is not what someone searching for a med spa wants. You decide what we produce for each, and what we stop producing.
* The outcome numbers. Pages indexed, pages earning impressions, keywords ranked, clicks, and calls and bookings we can trace back to a page. Not output volume. Where those numbers should be is yours to argue.


 If you find yourself writing blogs, something upstream is broken, and that is the thing to fix.
   

  

**Who You Probably Are**
* You have personally made local pages rank for hundreds of small businesses, at an agency or on a marketplace, and can explain exactly what did it.
* You write well and can say precisely why a paragraph is bad, in one sentence.
* You read Search Console before you form an opinion.
* You have worked with model\-generated content and hold a view of it that is neither hype nor contempt.
* You can write a rubric, argue with an engineer about an eval, and lose the argument gracefully when the data says so.
* You have real experience with US local search, wherever you sit.


 This is not a content calendar role, a people\-management role, a brand copy role or a social media role. It reports into product, works daily with the pipeline engineers, and starts with no team.
   

  

 Skills: local seo,google business profile,editorial judgment paired with seo
