The role involves close collaboration with OEMs, Tier\-1 suppliers, ecosystem partners, and internal engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle, from architecture definition and design\-in through production launch and post\-launch support.
* The candidate will develop and maintain high\-quality technical collateral including application notes, hardware design guidelines, safety concept documentation, platform integration guides, reference schematics, debug methodologies, and training materials. These deliverables will be leveraged globally by customer engineering teams and customers to accelerate product development and reduce integration risk.
* The candidate will lead system architecture reviews and hardware design reviews, evaluate customer implementations, and provide expert technical guidance on Qualcomm solutions. Responsibilities include analyzing complex system\-level issues, driving root cause investigations across hardware and software domains, optimizing platform performance, and delivering timely technical responses to customer inquiries and escalations.
* The role requires deep understanding of SoC architectures, high\-speed interfaces, power management, functional safety, signal integrity, memory subsystems, display/camera technologies, networking, and embedded software interactions. The candidate will work closely with chipset development, systems engineering, product management, safety, software, and validation teams to ensure successful customer deployments.
* The candidate will serve as a key technical interface between customers and Qualcomm engineering teams, driving issue resolution, risk mitigation, and program execution. Strong cross\-functional leadership skills are required to coordinate activities across multiple global teams and ensure alignment on technical deliverables and program milestones.
* Prior experience working in Automotive hardware and software domains, including collaboration with architecture, system, validation, safety, BSP, middleware, and application teams, is highly desirable. Experience supporting customer engagements, product commercialization, design troubleshooting, and production launches in automotive environments will be a significant advantage.

title: VIDEO EDITOR
description:
**Bangalore \| Full time \| 1 to 4 Years Experience****English, Hindi \& Kannada** **If you can find the 5 seconds everyone needs to see, read on.**
You know when a 30 minute speech has **one moment worth watching?**
We’re looking for a **Video Editor** who can find it, cut it, and make people stop scrolling.
This isn’t just about knowing Premiere Pro.  

It’s about having the editing instinct to know **what stays, what goes, where the cut lands, when the music hits, and what keeps someone watching.**
You understand political storytelling, short form content, internet culture, and how content moves online.### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Edit political content for **Instagram Reels, YouTube, Facebook, X \& WhatsApp**
* Turn speeches, interviews, rallies, event footage, explainers and campaign videos into sharp, engaging, platform native content
* Watch long form footage and identify the strongest **hooks, moments and soundbites**
* Create cuts, transitions, subtitles, text animations, graphics, motion and visual effects that add to the story
* Get the **pace, context and visual language** right for every platform
* Adapt videos across different formats, durations, aspect ratios and languages
* Work closely with writers, graphic designers, photographers, strategists and campaign teams
* Handle multiple edits and priorities without letting quality or attention to detail slip
* Deliver high quality work on tight deadlines

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1 to 4 years** of experience as a Video Editor, preferably in political campaigns, digital media, advertising, news or other high volume content environments
* Strong command of **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* Knowledge of **DaVinci Resolve** is a plus
* Strong understanding of **Reels, Shorts, YouTube and social first video**
* Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, music, typography and visual composition
* Ability to take raw footage and figure out **what the story actually is**
* Ability to work quickly in a fast moving, deadline heavy environment
* Strong command of **English, Hindi \& Kannada**, including the political and cultural context behind the content
* Comfortable making creative decisions independently and adapting to changing priorities

### **WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* You’ve edited **political campaigns, news or public facing content** before
* Strong motion graphics and animation skills
* You understand **internet culture, memes and emerging formats**
* You have a sharp eye for **colour, sound design and visual storytelling**
* You can spot a killer clip before someone has to tell you it’s a killer clip
* Your portfolio demonstrates **social first editing instincts**, not just technical skills

### **THE SKILL WE’RE REALLY HIRING FOR**

**Editing judgement.**
Knowing that the 30 minute speech has **one line that changes everything.**
Knowing when to cut.
Knowing when to hold.
Knowing when the music should hit.
Knowing what makes someone watch till the end.
We’re hiring the person who knows:**“This is the moment.”**### **WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


This is not:**Import footage**  **make cuts**  **export**  **next.**
Politics moves fast. News breaks. Narratives change.
A clip that matters at **2 PM might be irrelevant by 6 PM.**
You’ll need to work with **speed, pressure, ambiguity and real time creative decisions.**### **WHY JOIN US?**


You’ll work at the intersection of **politics, video, culture and the internet.**
You’ll work alongside campaign strategists, writers, designers, social media teams and political professionals, creating content that is actually part of the conversation.**Your edits won’t just sit in a folder.****People will see them.**### **HOW TO APPLY**

**Don’t just send us your CV. Show us what you can do.**
Send your **CV \+ showreel/portfolio** to:**mailto:contact@designboxed.com****Bonus points for:*** 3 to 5 edits you’re genuinely proud of
* Political, news, advertising or digital campaign work
* Anything that demonstrates your **editing instinct, storytelling ability and creative judgement**

  

If you can take raw footage, find the story, and turn it into something people actually want to watch,**we want to see your work.**

title: Manager - Trainer
description:
****Position Title****
 Manager \- Trainer
   

  

****Purpose of Role****
 To build and run TEPCO's site training capability — developing and executing the training modules for mechanized, assembly\-line transmission construction with core purpose of optimizing man days in all the phases of construction, and, most importantly,
 **driving their adoption on the ground** 
 so that gangs work to the new method with confidence, consistency and pace.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities / Responsibilities**
**Training design \& Content development**
* Conduct change management workshops with Projects, Gang Leaders \& all workers.
* Develop and maintain training modules for the assembly\-line methodology and mechanized construction techniques (e.g. DAGP erection, drone\-based stringing), covering each sub\-gang role across foundation, erection and stringing.
* Build simple, field\-usable
* Training materials
* SOPs,
* Visual work instructions
* job aids
* Toolbox\-talk content
* Videos and Demonstrations
* Equipment Operating Guides
* Quick Reference Cards
* Translate technical procedures into practical site level instructions suitable for workforce with varying literacy and experience levels.


**Adoption on site — the core of the role**
* Run structured on\-site induction and hands\-on training at mobilization , and refresher training at the start of each project.
* Work alongside gangs at the work\-front to embed the assembly\-line method, coach on cycle\-time discipline, and troubleshoot resistance or bottlenecks as they arise.
* Partner with the Project Manager, Mechanization leads and vertical teams to sequence training with the execution plan, so training enables the schedule rather than interrupting it.
* Identify and develop experienced workers as peer trainers, creating a self\-sustaining training capability at site.
* Identify high potential workers and prepare succession plans for critical gang and equipment operator positions.
* Enhancing schedule adherence through the effective adoption of mechanized construction methodologies.


**Measurement and improvement**
* Track training coverage, competency levels, and the link between training and on\-ground productivity (progress toward the man\-days/km target).
* Create a competency grading system (Beginner, skilled , advanced, export) to support workforce planning.
* Feed field observations back into module design, continuously improving both the method and the training.
* Establish the foundations of a repeatable, scalable training programme that can be rolled out to future TEPCO sites and, in time, a team.
* Create a train the trainer program to build scalable internal capabilities across all our projects.
* Monitor cycle times and identify operational inefficiencies impacting productivity.
* Conduct RCA of productivity analysis attributable to manpower skill gaps and implement corrective action/developmental plans


**Safety plus Quality Training \& Compliance**
* Ensuring all compliance w.r.t. QHSE pre\-requisites viz. required TPI of all machines, running essential checks on SOP requirements, Training w.r.t. safety aspects.
* Ensure all workers are trained and certified for critical construction activities before deployment.
* Conduct regular safety awareness sessions and practical demonstrations.
* Track effectiveness of safety training through reduction in unsafe acts, near misses, and incidents.
* Develop quality\-focused skill assessments and certification standards for critical activities.


****Position Demands****
 Frequent Travel to Project Sites
   

  

****Competencies****
 Behavioural \- Achievement Orientation
   

  

 Behavioural \- Altrocentric Leadership
   

  

 Behavioural \- Initiative
   

  

 Behavioural \- Innovative Thinking
   

  

 Functional \- Financial
   

  

 Functional \- Operational
   

  

 Functional \- People
   

  

 Functional \- Strategic

**About the Role** 
  
 



 Evervie is building a new specialty care vertical focused on women's health, a ground\-up clinical model spanning diagnosis, treatment protocols, and a physician panel. We're hiring a Clinical Associate to sit in the founder's office and work directly with the Director of Clinical Innovation across nearly every clinical workstream in the build: guidelines, patient segmentation, physician recruitment, and partner tie\-ups. **Contract:** 
 6 months to 1 year, with potential to continue post\-launch based on performance

 Director of Clinical Innovation and Medical Director

*Clinical guidelines \& protocols:* 
  
 


* Support development and documentation of clinical guidelines — screening protocols, contraindication checklists, and treatment pathways

**What we're looking for:** 
  
 


* MBBS\+ preferred; open to strong candidates from nursing or allied health backgrounds

* Strong research and documentation skills; able to synthesize clinical literature and guidelines into clear, usable material

* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to own tasks end\-to\-end with minimal handholding

**Nice to have:** 
  
 


* Prior exposure to women's health, gynaecology, or endocrinology
* Experience or coursework in clinical research, public health, or health systems
* Familiarity with telemedicine regulations or digital health delivery model

title: SNC Technician
description:
**Composites \& Structures Technician \| Apollyon Dynamics Private Limited** 




*Location: Hyderabad* 




  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for a Composites \& Structures Technician to build airframe and structural components for our unmanned aerial platforms. You will work directly with the design team on mould layup, resin systems and finishing, taking parts from raw material to flight\-ready structure with responsibility for strength, weight and surface quality. This is a hands\-on shop\-floor role in a fast\-paced R\&D environment, with shift\-based working.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 • Perform hand layup, wet layup and vacuum bagging of composite structures (carbon fibre, fibreglass, aramid)
 



 • Prepare, maintain and release moulds/tooling for layup operations
 



 • Mix and apply resins, hardeners and matrix systems per process specifications and ratios
 



 • Monitor curing cycles (oven/autoclave) and ensure process compliance
 



 • Trim, sand and surface\-finish composite parts to specified tolerance and finish standards
 



 • Bond and assemble composite sub\-structures using structural adhesives and bonding techniques
 



 • Inspect parts for defects (voids, delamination, porosity, dry spots) and rework as needed
 



 • Support related machining and cutting operations on composite and structural parts using standard shop tools
 



 • Maintain tooling, consumables and workshop housekeeping/safety standards
 



 • Work with the design team on manufacturability and process improvement
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





 • Hands\-on experience in composite layup (hand layup/wet layup, vacuum bagging)
 



 • Working knowledge of resins, matrix systems, hardeners and mixing ratios
 



 • Experience with mould preparation, release agents and mould maintenance
 



 • Skilled in surface finishing — sanding, filling, trimming to specified finish
 



 • Familiarity with basic machining and hand tools
 



 • Ability to read engineering drawings and process sheets
 



 • ITI, Diploma or equivalent in Mechanical/Production/Composite Engineering
 



 • Willingness to work in shifts and in a fast\-paced, R\&D\-driven environment
 



 • Willingness to join as soon as possible
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Experience with prepreg composites or autoclave curing
 



 • Exposure to aerospace or defence composite structures
 



 • Experience with structural bonding/assembly of UAV airframes

 hiring@apollyondynamics.com / chirag.shet@apollyondynamics.com / neeraj@apollyondynamics.com

title: Senior Medical Information Writer
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
 At EVERSANA, our integrated life sciences compliance team is taking a leading role in helping some of the most scientifically advanced Biopharma and research companies around the world to innovate novel therapies for rare, ultra\-rare and a range of critical therapeutic areas including Oncology, Neurology, Immuno\-oncology, Immunology, etc. This role is within the EVERSANA Compliance team, reporting directly to the Director, Medical Content Development and Medical Review. This person will also collaborate very closely with other team members within the EVERSANA Compliance Business Unit (Medical Information (MI), and Medical Affairs).
   

  

 This position will support various types of clients including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, digital therapeutics, and over\-the\-counter companies. This position is responsible for MI content development\-related client engagements.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
   

  

* Develop, review, and maintain scientifically accurate, evidence\-based Medical Information (MI) content, including Scientific Response Documents (SRDs), Global Response Documents (GRDs), Customized Response Documents (CRDs), FAQs, cover letters, training materials, and other medical information and scientific communication resources.
* Independently manage the end\-to\-end MI content development lifecycle, including literature searches, synthesis of evidence, content authoring, incorporation of stakeholder feedback, document finalization, and coordination of Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes.
* Serve as the primary content owner within document management systems (Veeva Vault Systems), ensuring accurate document upload, lifecycle management, version control, reference linking, annotation, and compliance with documentation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct quality control and peer reviews, scientific data verification, and reference validation to ensure accuracy, consistency, scientific rigor, and compliance of MI deliverables.
* Manage translation requests and coordinate with external translation vendors to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality, scientifically accurate, and locally compliant medical information materials.
* Participate in client\-facing and internal meetings to provide scientific expertise, project updates, and recommendations on MI content and communication strategies.
* Support the development, review, and continuous enhancement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, templates, style guides, quality checklists, and process documentation to drive operational excellence and compliance.
* Ensure all medical information materials are scientifically balanced, evidence\-based, compliant with applicable regulatory and company requirements, and aligned with industry best practices.
* Responsible for proactively flagging and managing any quality issues, and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions
* Stays knowledgeable of industry best practices and supports leadership team in evaluating and implementing new technologies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and quality of materials developed.
* Works collaboratively with other medical writers and creative teams across EVERSANA.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.


**Expectations Of The Job**
* Responsible for delivering CLIENT DELIGHT
* Responsible for working collaboratively with EVERSANA medical information and medical affairs team and taking directions and feedback from management and clients
* Responsible for ensuring management and compliance with industry standards and codes


 of practice
   

  

* Able to work independently to develop high\-quality, scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, ethical, and compliant medical content
* Responsible to proactively flag and manage any quality issues, and ensure timely


 corrective and preventive actions
   

  

* Hours: Able to work full time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management. (40\+ hours per week, 5 days of the week)


**Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
 The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
   

  

* Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or healthcare; Master’s, PhD, or PharmD preferred
* Experience: Minimum of 2 years of MI writing and medical content development experience
* Exceptional communication skills include written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results.
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meetings or exceeding timelines.
* Familiarity with AMA Style guide as well as an understanding of clinical research principles and applied statistics. Familiarity with International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE), Good Publication Practices (GPP), and other medical publishing guidelines (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta\-Analyses (PRISMA), Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE), Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT), etc.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non\-promotional materials review.
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven; ability to manage
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions
* Highly principled – proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior
* Collaboration – Ability to work cross functionally across EVERSANA business units and with various clients, including leadership and various departments and functions of our clients
* Agile learning – Ability to support and learn about multiple disease states and therapeutic areas


**Qualifications**
* Education: PharmD (or M. Pharm or M.S. Pharm), PhD, or MD
* Experience: Strong expertise in MI content development and scientific writing, with a track record of delivering accurate, evidence\-based, and compliant medical communications.
* Broad therapeutic area experience with the ability to effectively manage diverse product portfolios and complex scientific content.
* Proficiency in Veeva Vault System, including document management, workflow administration, content promotion processes, and MLR review support.


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
   

  

 From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
 The management of Medical Affairs and Medical Information (MA/MI) content, systems, and data is critical to ensuring medical information resources remain accurate, compliant, accessible, and appropriately governed. Effective execution of these activities requires strong oversight of content classification, user administration, system support, reporting, and document governance processes.
   

  

 As part of the MA/MI Operations team, the MA/MI Content Management \& System Specialist is responsible for supporting Medical Information systems and content management operations for dedicated clients. The role oversees user management activities, access controls, content classification, metadata governance, system support, reporting, and procedural document management. The specialist works closely with internal stakeholders and support teams to ensure seamless system operations, maintain data quality and consistency, support audits and system releases, and ensure compliance with internal policies, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
   

  

**User Management Support**
* Coordinate and support user onboarding and offboarding activities within Medical Information (MI) systems.
* Initiate and track training assignment requests for system users.
* Support updates and maintenance of training content.
* Perform user access management activities for MI systems and maintain the user management master file
* Monitor and resolve complaint and incident tickets raised by MI system users.
* Monitor Medical Information support mailboxes and Teams channels, responding to and resolving user requests and issues in a timely manner.
* Update data reports, Power BI dashboards, and maintain SharePoint lists for non\-Med Source users
* Provide support to the team responsible for managing the Talent Share tool and associated training and learning activities.
* Liaise with internal support teams for interconnected systems and applications
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) script development and functionality testing during MI system releases
* Provide support during audits.
* Support the governance, oversight, and management of classification processes for MI enquiries and MI documents.
* Support the oversight, planning, review, approval, and maintenance of procedural documents


**Classification Support**
* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information enquiry cases.
* Perform metadata classification for Medical Information response documents.
* Conduct periodic normalization, harmonization, and maintenance of classifications in alignment with approved lists and established classification standards.


**Medical Affairs and Medical Information Project Management Support**
* Support MA/MI leadership in developing and managing project plans for key initiatives
* Assist in the development and maintenance of project plans and related documentation
* Support the medical content development team in uploading materials into clients’ review and approval platforms, including supporting annotating, anchoring references, etc.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.


 Consistent with applicable disability, employment, and human rights laws in the jurisdictions in which EVERSANA operates, EVERSANA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, unless providing such an accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden on EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your position, please contact Human Resources.
   

  

**Expectations Of The Job**
* Travel: In general, this position does not travel.
* Hours: Able to work full\-time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management.
* Metrics: Maintain and contribute toward process improvement which positively impacts metrics associated with activities of the MLR Review process; metrics are subject to change annually or more often as deemed necessary.

*An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.*

 The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
   

  

* Education: Graduates in any Life Sciences / Biomedical field.
* Must demonstrate excellent ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing.
* Experience and/or Training:
+ A minimum of 2 years of experience in a healthcare agency, pharmaceutical company contact center, or an equivalent environment, with exposure to quality control processes
+ Experience with use of Veeva Vault PromoMats / MedComms / CRM
+ Experience in MLR Coordination
+ Project management
+ Time management
+ Meeting management

* Excellent customer service skills.
* Technology/Equipment: Computer proficiency in Outlook and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Windows applications).


**Qualifications**
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Education: Graduates/Postgraduates in Pharmacy or Medicine preferred.
* Experience and/or Training
+ Working knowledge of or familiarity with global healthcare compliance statutes and laws.
+ Ability to perform assignments with a high degree of independence requiring extensive experience, skill, and knowledge
+ Excellent computer skills including competency in presentation, word processing and spreadsheet software, utilizing MS Office Suite.
+ Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities and meet deadlines
+ Ability to manage cross\-functional projects
+ Familiar with laws and regulations regarding US drug / device advertising and promotion, including industry best practices

**Additional Information**

 Job Purpose
 





 The Monitoring and Documentation Officer will support the effective implementation, tracking, documentation, reporting, and knowledge management processes of the Transform Schools programme. S/He/They will be responsible for collecting quality data by following established processes, maintaining accurate programme records, tracking implementation progress, coordinating routine data collection, compiling field evidence, developing written and photo\-based case studies, and documenting programme learnings, insights, success stories, and best practices.

* Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual programme progress summaries.

* Develop and maintain organised documentation systems (digital and physical) for programme records.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data collection, processing, and reporting to support evidence\-based decision\-making and knowledge sharing..
* Compile training reports, meeting minutes, attendance records, field visit reports, photographs, case studies, and other supporting evidence.
* Document programme learnings, best practices, innovations, and field\-level experiences.
* Draft success stories, human\-interest stories, and short programme briefs for internal and external communication.
* Support the preparation of donor documentation and programme communication materials.


-

* Support data cleaning, verification, and analysis using EXCEL, PYTHON, R, etc., in coordination with programme and M\&E teams.
* Ensure safe storage and retrieval of programme records and supporting documents.
* Lead the design, management, and continuous improvement of digital data collection systems to ensure timely, accurate, and efficient programme data capture.



  






 4\. Reporting Support
 



* Support the preparation of periodic programme reports by collating field inputs and documentation.
* Coordinate with programme teams to obtain timely updates and supporting evidence for reporting requirements.
* Assist in formatting reports, presentations, annexures, and documentation packages.
* Ensure that all reports are submitted within agreed timelines and in the required format.



  






 Essential Requirements 
 



* Bachelor's degree in social sciences, education, public administration, development studies, statistics, economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in programme monitoring, documentation, reporting, MIS, or administrative support in the education or development sector.

**The Technical Writer is responsible for converting, migrating, formatting, and maintaining technical documentation from legacy formats, primarily PDF documents and, where applicable, Adobe FrameMaker source files, into Microsoft Word in accordance with Baker Hughes documentation standards, templates, and style guidelines. The role involves ensuring document accuracy, formatting consistency, content integrity, and compliance with established documentation requirements. The Technical Writer will support documentation modernization initiatives and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality technical publications.**

 **Minimum Requirements**


A successful candidate will have:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Technical Writing, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution, OR equivalent professional experience.

* Experience working with PDF\-based technical documentation.
* Experience converting and formatting technical documents in Microsoft Word while maintaining content accuracy and consistency.
* Basic familiarity with Adobe FrameMaker is desirable but not mandatory.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, SnagIt, or similar documentation tools.

description:
UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.
   

  

 At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.
   

  

 UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

 Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.
   

  

**For every child, the right to advocacy.**
**How can you make a difference?**
 At UNICEF Gujarat field office, communication, advocacy and partnership is working with stakeholders to advance child rights priorities and strengthen public, institutional and stakeholder engagement for issues impacting adolescents and young people. These efforts aim to address gaps in visibility, public discourse, policy attention, social mobilization and partnership\-building around key programme priorities, including health, nutrition, education, child protection, climate action, gender equality, adolescent participation and youth engagement.
   

  

 The UNICEF Gujarat Field Office in delivering outcomes aligned with the UNICEF Strategic Plan through:
   

  

* Convening: Engaging key stakeholders and influencers, including government departments, media, legislators, civil society, youth and adolescent platforms, CSR partners, private sector actors, academia, and digital influencers to advance child rights priorities in Gujarat.
* Converging: Facilitating programme integration and joint action across relevant government departments, UNICEF programme sections and partners by translating programme evidence, field insights and state priorities into strategic advocacy, communication and partnership initiatives.
* Catalyzing: Driving public discourse, policy attention, stakeholder action and resource mobilization, both financial and non\-financial, to support priority child rights issues and strengthen visibility, partnerships and advocacy outcomes for children and young people in Gujarat.


 The UNICEF Gujarat office is looking for consultant who will provide specialized, time\-bound technical support to develop and deliver a defined set of communication, advocacy, stakeholder engagement and documentation products that strengthen UNICEF Gujarat's visibility, public discourse, evidence\-based advocacy and partnership engagement around identified child rights priorities.
   

  

 If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here:
 ***Communication, Advocacy and Partnership Consultant \- External TOR.pdf***
***To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have...***
**Minimum Requirements**
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Communications, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Relations or another relevant discipline.

- Work Experience:

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in strategic communication, advocacy, media engagement, development communication, public relations or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience developing communication and advocacy products for government, development organizations, UN agencies, NGOs or comparable institutions.
* Experience in stakeholder engagement and partnership development.
* Experience in developing human\-interest stories, social media content and documentation products.
* Knowledge/Expertise/Skills:
+ Strong knowledge of strategic communication, advocacy, media engagement, social and behaviour change communication, and development communication.
+ Demonstrated skills in stakeholder mapping, partnership analysis, media database development, influencer mapping and CSR/private\-sector engagement.
+ Excellent writing, editing, documentation and storytelling skills, including experience preparing human\-interest stories, social media content, reports, briefs and advocacy materials.
+ Strong coordination, interpersonal and analytical skills, with the ability to consult multiple stakeholders and deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.
+ Proficiency in MS Office applications and familiarity with digital and social media platforms, content planning tools and basic data management.
+ Language Requirements:
- Fluency in English and Hindi is required.
- Working knowledge of Gujarati will be an asset, particularly for stakeholder engagement, field documentation and review of state\-level communication materials.


* Desirables:
+ Prior experience working with UNICEF, UN agencies, government departments, development partners or civil society organisations will be an advantage.
+ Experience working in Gujarat or with state\-level stakeholders, media networks, youth platforms, CSR partners or private\-sector entities is desirable.
+ Experience in developing visually engaging communication products, social media packages, advocacy briefs, campaign materials or knowledge documentation will be an asset.


**For every Child, you demonstrate...**
 UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values
   

  

 UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio\-economic background, minority, or any other status.
   

  

 UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility \| UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance.

**Description**
 This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

****About EAII****
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here:
   

  

****About Evidence Action****
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

****Requirements****
 The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
   

  

 (i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water\-treatment arrangements; and
   

  

 (ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems .
   

  

 The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
   

  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe\-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan).
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution \- addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet\-based dozers and other chlorination options.


 The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
   

  

**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**
* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O\&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states


**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**
* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O\&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late\-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water\-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non\-viable across different rural water\-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising


**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**
* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale\-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale\-up


**Requirements**
* 15\+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water\-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred.
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India.
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non\-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership


**Position Location**
**This is a 6\-month consultancy engagement,** 
 with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.

Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

 for our AI\-first content operations team.
 





 We build lead\-generation websites for SMBs across Europe. AI generates the first draft of website content and blogs;

**What You'll Do** 
* Review AI\-generated German website content and blogs.

* Detect hallucinations, factual errors, missing information and unsupported claims.
* Fix awkward, repetitive, generic or unnatural German.

* Write/edit CTAs, button text, headings, meta titles/descriptions and alt text.
* Apply defined
 
**SEO, AEO and GEO** 

 content best practices.
* Ensure content supports the customer's intended audience and conversion objective.
* Use GPT and other AI tools to improve quality and productivity.
* Flag unclear information instead of making assumptions.


**What We're Looking For** 
* Strong practical written German.
* Good working English.
* Strong German grammar, vocabulary and language comprehension.
* Excellent attention to detail and critical thinking.
* Ability to understand and follow structured briefs.
* Comfortable learning and working with AI tools.
* Interest in digital content, SEO, AEO and GEO.
* Ability to learn quickly and take ownership of your work.



**Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.** 





 Candidates who studied
 
**German as a third language through Class 12** 

 may also apply. Formal German degrees or certifications are not mandatory; selection will be based on demonstrated German proficiency and performance in our practical assessment.
 



**AI\-First Performance Culture** 


 At Adaan, AI isn't an occasional tool—it's part of everyday execution.
 





 We expect you to use AI intelligently while remaining accountable for the final output. “AI generated it” isn't a reason to accept inaccurate or poor\-quality content.
 





 Performance is measured on quality, timeliness and productivity, including:
 



* **97%\+ First Time Right (FTR)**
* **97%\+ On Time Every Time (OTET)**
* Brief and checklist compliance
* Content accuracy and language quality
* Effective use of AI
* Continuous productivity improvement




 Performance is reviewed through structured monthly check\-ins.
 





 Adaan works with global markets, so ownership of client delivery commitments is expected across time zones and, when genuinely required, weekends or Indian public holidays.
 



**Compensation \& Growth** 


 We follow a
 
**fixed pay \+ performance\-linked variable pay** 

 model.
 





 High performers can earn disproportionately more. Average performance earns average pay.
 
**Impact is rewarded—not effort alone.** 





 You can grow from German HITL/content quality into
 
**Senior Content Quality, SEO/AEO/GEO, Multilingual Quality, AI Content Operations or AI Workflow Optimization** 

 roles.
 



**Why Adaan?** 


 This isn't a conventional content\-writing job.
 





 You'll learn to work at the intersection of
 
**German \+ AI \+ Content Quality \+ SEO \+ AEO \+ GEO \+ Digital Operations** 

 .
 





 If you're curious about AI, strong with language, attentive to detail and want to build skills for the next generation of digital work, we'd like to hear from you.

**Programme Associate \- Industrial Heat Decarbonisation** 




  





 The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST), is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience knowledge of working in Energy Efficiency, Energy management, Boiler\-based industries, and MSME sectors such as\- Food \& beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma etc. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





***About iFOREST***




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



***The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme***




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at\-risk MSME sectors, as a transition in these sectors will affect the largest number of consumers and enterprises.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



***The Role***




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.
 



  





 Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
 



**Support and execute the research initiatives of the Programme.** 



* Contribute to designing research assignments, including developing research strategy and methodology as well as identifying specific activities and tasks.
* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.
* Write research documents, including analytical reports and policy papers based on evidence.
* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.



  





**Lead the outreach and communication** 



* Design and manage a comprehensive outreach strategy for the programme as well as for projects therein.
* Enable the generation of policy\-research partnerships with government, industry and other stakeholders.
* Author and review articles and other forms of communication materials suitable for the public, government stakeholders, and donors.

**Additional duties** 



* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector\-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.



  





***Qualification \& Work Experience***



* A Bachelors or
 **Master's in engineering is a must, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Energy System, and Environmental or related streams.**
* The candidate must have experience of research and work on
 **Energy efficiency; Energy Management; Boiler\-based industries and efficiency of MSME sectors, such as\- Food and Beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma, etc.**

 **minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience**

title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
**About Us**
 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.
   

  

 For the better. Together.
   

  

 Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Learning strategy and capability building
   

  

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


 Learning design and development
   

  

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


 Talent and leadership development
   

  

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


 Organizational development
   

  

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


 Learning technology and measurement
   

  

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.


**About You**
 Must\-have
   

  

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


 Nice\-to\-have
   

  

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.


**How You Work**
 We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:
   

  

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


 Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!
   

  

 If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!

title: Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview** 




**We are looking for a strong Content \& Creative Ideation professional to lead content development and communication across Baidyanath Ayurveda and Goodcare.** 
 This is not a traditional content\-writing role. The person will be expected to develop ideas, campaign concepts, brand narratives and platform\-specific content across social media, creative, video, digital campaigns, performance marketing, websites, marketplaces and other consumer touchpoints.
 



 The ideal candidate should understand how modern consumer brands communicate digitally and should be able to balance brand storytelling with content that drives engagement, consideration and conversion.
 



**Preferred Experience / Brand Exposure** 




 Preferred candidates will have worked with a leading creative or digital agency handling FMCG, Health \& Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Nutrition or D2C brands, or have direct brand\-side experience with digitally forward consumer brands.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Content Strategy \& Ideation** 



* Develop the content approach for Baidyanath Ayurveda and Goodcare while keeping the identity, audience and communication style of both brands distinct.
* Generate campaign ideas, content properties, social concepts, creative hooks and communication narratives aligned with brand and business objectives.
* Translate marketing briefs into strong communication ideas and executable content.
* Identify relevant consumer trends, cultural moments, health/wellness conversations and occasions that the brands can participate in.
* Build recurring and ownable content formats rather than relying only on topical or product\-led posts.
* Develop content themes across Ayurveda, health, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, nutrition, FMCG and preventive healthcare.



**2\. Social Media Content Management** 



* Own ideation and copy development across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Develop monthly content calendars, post concepts, captions, carousel stories, Reels/Shorts ideas, product communication, educational content, engagement content and moment marketing.
* Adapt communication by platform, audience and objective rather than replicating the same content across channels.
* Work with social, design and video teams to ensure content is execution\-ready and delivered on time.



**3\. Short\-form Content** 



* Develop concepts and scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, influencer content, UGC videos, performance ads, product demonstrations, expert\-led videos and testimonials.
* Create strong hooks and scripts using a clear structure such as Hook \> Story \> Product Integration \> Benefit \> CTA.
* Simplify health, wellness and product benefits into engaging, consumer\-friendly communication.



**4\. Long\-form Content** 



* Develop and/or manage website content, product pages, blogs, SEO articles, campaign landing pages, brand stories, educational articles and product education.
* Create marketplace A\+ content, brochures, catalogues, longer video scripts, leadership/founder communication, thought\-leadership content and CRM/WhatsApp/Email communication.
* Maintain factual accuracy while ensuring the language remains simple, relevant and engaging for the intended audience.



**5\. Creative Ideation \& Copywriting** 



* Work closely with designers and creative teams to develop campaign key visuals, headlines, taglines, digital ads, performance creatives, marketplace banners, website banners, POSM and BTL communication.
* Contribute to packaging communication and print communication where required.
* Operate as an ideator, not only as a copywriter receiving briefs: originate the idea and then work with design/video teams to bring it alive.



**6\. Brand Tonality Management** 




**Baidyanath Ayurveda:** 
 Trust, heritage, Ayurveda expertise, efficacy, family wellness, preventive healthcare and credibility. The communication should make a legacy Ayurvedic brand feel contemporary and relevant without losing its authority.
 



**Goodcare:** 
 Modern, digital\-forward, conversational, younger, lifestyle\-oriented, benefit\-driven and social\-first.
 



**7\. Campaign Development** 



* Partner with the cross\-functional team on new product launches, seasonal campaigns, category\-building, product education, influencer campaigns, performance campaigns, marketplace campaigns, festive campaigns and brand\-building initiatives.
* Translate one central campaign thought into multiple formats across social, video, digital, commerce and offline touchpoints.



**8\. Content Calendar, Governance \& Coordination** 



* Develop and manage monthly and quarterly content calendars with visibility of upcoming campaigns, business priorities and product launches.
* Coordinate with activation, social, design, performance, e\-commerce, marketplace, product/R\&D and agency teams.
* Maintain consistency in messaging and tonality across touchpoints and keep a repository of approved content, product claims and creative assets.
* Track performance of major content formats and use learnings to improve future communication.



**9\. Performance \& Commerce Content** 



* Develop communication for Meta ads, Google/YouTube creatives, marketplace ads, D2C website campaigns, retargeting, problem\-solution communication and promotional campaigns.
* Understand the difference between Brand Content, Engagement Content, Performance Content and Commerce Content, and tailor the writing accordingly.



**10\. Trend \& Competition Tracking** 



* Regularly study digital\-first FMCG, wellness, beauty and D2C brands to identify emerging formats, consumer language, category trends and creative opportunities.
* Bring relevant learnings into Baidyanath and Goodcare without copying competitor communication.



**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in content, creative strategy, copywriting, digital content or brand communication.
* Preferably from a digital/creative agency environment handling FMCG, Health \& Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Nutrition or D2C brands.
* Alternatively, strong brand\-side experience with a digitally driven consumer brand.
* Prior experience on social\-first and/or D2C brands is strongly preferred.



**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent written English with strong command over headlines, hooks and short\-form copy.
* Ability to simplify complex health/product information without diluting the core benefit.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and digital\-first consumer communication.
* Experience writing short\-form video scripts and developing campaign ideas beyond executional copy.
* Strong storytelling, presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously.
* Comfort working closely with designers, editors, agencies, social teams and performance teams.
* Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Understanding of Ayurveda, wellness, nutrition, beauty or healthcare categories.
* Knowledge of Hindi and/or Bengali will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of SEO and marketplace content such as Amazon A\+.
* Understanding of influencer, UGC and performance content.
* Ability to interpret basic social and content performance metrics.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* An ideator first and writer second.
* Naturally curious about brands, consumers, culture and digital trends.
* Comfortable generating multiple creative routes for one brief.
* Able to spot a strong hook, campaign thought or storytelling angle.
* Equally comfortable writing a five\-word headline and a long\-form article.
* Capable of challenging repetitive or predictable content.
* Commercially aware and understands that content must support brand and business growth.



**This is not a role for someone whose experience is primarily limited to SEO blogs or generic social\-media captions.** 




**The candidate should be able to answer: “What should the brand say, why should the consumer care, and what is the most interesting way to say it?”** 




**Key Deliverables / KPIs** 



* Quality and originality of content ideas and campaign thinking.
* Improvement in social engagement and overall content effectiveness.
* Quality of short\-form video concepts and scripts.
* Consistency and distinctiveness of Baidyanath and Goodcare brand tonality.
* Timeliness of content planning and delivery.
* Reduction in repetitive/generic communication.
* Contribution to product launches, digital campaigns and commerce requirements.
* Ability to convert marketing briefs into execution\-ready creative ideas.



**Portfolio Requirement** 




 Candidates should submit a portfolio containing examples of:
 


* Social media campaigns and content properties
* Reels / short\-form video scripts
* Campaign concepts and key creative ideas
* Headlines / digital advertisements
* Long\-form writing
* Brand launches or integrated campaigns

 Khan Academy India aims to deliver a world class user experience to learners in India that is locally relevant and is enabled by a strong on\-the\-ground team and operations. Our learning system is mastery based, which allows students to master key concepts at a pace that’s right for them before moving on to more challenging content. From serving under 500,000 learners in 2016, we are now serving almost 4 million learners a month across our websites, apps and youtube channels. These learners include both independent learners accessing us at home and teacher directed learners in schools.  We are looking for a Program Documentation and Learning Coordinator to streamline our knowledge management. title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Senior Copywriter — CRM, Product \& App (AI\-first)
 



 Team: Brand
 



 Works with: CRM \& Retention, Product UX, App Merchandise, CX
 



 Experience: 3\+ years
 



 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore (In\-office)
 



  





**WHY DOES THIS ROLE EXIST?** 




 More of what we say to an existing pet parent goes out through CRM than through any campaign we’ll ever run. Push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp—it is our highest\-volume writing by a distance, and it’s the easiest place in the business for a voice to quietly go flat.
 



 It’s also where the money is. A pet parent who stays is worth more than one we win twice. Retention is a writing problem more often than anyone admits—the right words to the right cohort at the right moment, over and over.
 



 And the words don’t stop when the notification is tapped. The push lands, the app opens, and the same person now reads a home screen, a banner, an empty cart, an error, or a checkout button. If the message sounded like a friend and the app sounds like a form, we’ve lost the thread.
 



 Whoever writes the first line should have a hand in the next one.
 



 So, this role is CRM at its core, with two deliberate extensions: the product surfaces the message opens into and the app storefront it lands on.
 



  





**YOUR MISSION, SHOULD YOU CHOOSE TO ACCEPT** 




 • Think deeply about what pet parents would like, especially those who already trust us
 



 • Own every word we send an existing pet parent across push, email, in\-app and WhatsApp
 



 • Write to the cohort: new user, first order, repeat and lapsed
 



 • Map and write complete journeys across onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back
 



 • Carry the voice past the tap into onboarding screens, empty states, errors, confirmations and CTAs
 



 • Make the app storefront read like a shop someone wants to walk through, not a grid of SKUs
 



 • Test constantly, read the numbers and kill what loses—including the one you were proud of
 



 • Use AI to draft at volume, set up processes and ensure brand adherence at scale
 



 • Maintain a consistent brand personality across every channel and screen
 



 • Spot and avoid thnigs lyk thise
 



 • Collaborate with multiple internal teams to expedite the marketing team’s creative output
 



 • Create a tangible impact on the lives of pets and pet parents
 



 • Be around pets—a lot
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL OWN** 



1. CRM \& lifecycle copy



 Every lifecycle surface—push, email, in\-app, WhatsApp and SMS. Each message should be written for the cohort and have a clear objective. A first\-time parent three days in and a subscription lapse at ninety days are not the same person and should not receive the same sentence.
 



 2\.Journeys, not sends
 



 Onboarding, retention, re\-engagement and win\-back. Map the whole arc, then write it. A brilliant one\-off inside a broken flow is still a broken flow.
 



 3\.Optimisation \& testing
 



 Own an always\-on testing calendar across subject lines, hooks, CTAs, framing and length. Read the results and act on them. Retire what underperforms instead of letting it run simply because it exists.
 



 4\.AI\-first production
 



 Generate cohort variants at volume, then edit hard. Build prompt and template systems so quality is repeatable and doesn’t live only in your head.
 



 5\.Product UX writing
 



 Own the screens our messages open into: onboarding and account setup, empty states, error and edge\-case copy, confirmations, permissions, subscription and vet\-consult flows, and button labels.
 



 The writing should be short, clear, kind and unmistakably us. You’ll work with Product UX designers inside their files and flows—not on a document thrown over the wall. When a pattern repeats, you’ll write it once and add it to the UX copy library so it stays written.
 



 6\.App merchandising \& category copy
 



 Own the storefront: home screen and banner copy, collection and category names, shelf and carousel titles, in\-app sale and campaign framing, and PDP support copy where it moves the needle.
 



 Merchandising is a weekly rhythm, not a weekly rewrite. Template recurring asks so this remains a corner of the week—not the entire week.
 



  





 Support \& service content
 



 Work with the CX team on macros, canned replies, help\-centre copy and FAQs.
 



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




 • At least 3 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, retention or UX copywriting
 



 • Real exposure to product or in\-app writing, even if it wasn’t part of your job title
 



 • Comfort working in Figma, inside a flow and alongside a designer
 



 • Proficiency in spoken and written English
 



 • Strong attention to punctuation, grammar and spelling
 



 • Creativity with both words and ideas
 



 • Awareness of current trends and news
 



 • An understanding of the tone required for different audiences
 



 • Experience writing for different mediums and channels, especially short\-form and character\-limited formats
 



 • Real AI fluency
 



 • An understanding of how marketing campaigns are developed, with the ability to contribute insights and words that create coherent, impactful brand campaigns
 



 • Comfort being the only writer in a room of designers, PMs and merchandisers—and holding the line on voice
 



  





 Location: Indiranagar, Bangalore
 



 Work mode: In\-office

title: Technical Preparation Engineer
description:
