If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
   

  

**Position Description**
 The department of Manufacturing Engineering (ME\-BLR) is part of a global function that develops product and process solutions, leading to operational excellence. We deliver manufacturing engineering solutions to product projects for different truck product classes within Volvo group. It’s a place where we deliver and learn new technologies from both vehicle engineering and manufacturing engineering. In our team we work in a creative atmosphere with Manufacturing (Operations) and Product Development (Engineering) organizations.

 As a Technical Preparation Engineer (TPE) you will secure production quality for the Chassis engineering areas that are designed and developed by product development teams. You will be located at Bangalore office and will be supporting global vehicle engineering and ME sites.
   

  

 As a TPE, you will closely work with product development teams and secure manufacturing requirements during the product development phase, by providing right information to Engineering and performing assembly verifications.
   

  

**As a TPE, You Will Also**

* Create and deliver Delta T estimation.
* Close manufacturing related project issue logs
* Increase product commonality between the brands Volvo, Renault, Mack trucks
* Decrease number of parts and product diversity, assembly time and standard cost of sales
* Enhance ergonomics and assembly environment
* Increase manufacturing flexibility
* Implement physical module strategy
* Timely delivery of Technical Preparation documentation to plants.


**We Want You To Have**
* BE/BTech in Mechanical engineering degree or equivalent
* Minimum 5 years of automotive experience from product development or manufacturing engineering
* Good knowledge about trucks, especially in Chassis Engineering area
* Good knowledge of vehicle development Process
* Knowledge of the parts documentation and structuring (ex: KOLA)
* Knowledge of Creo, CATIA \& Windchill

**We Also Hope That You**

 Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
 **Volvo Group** 
 . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Generalist- GTM X Product (Internship)
description:

 **GTM, Product and Operations**

* Building internal processes and systems in our journey

**Who Should apply ?**

 ***a particular college, degree or background.***

 **figuring things out** 
 .
* Someone who can be given a problem, spend the time understanding it properly, do the research, talk to the right people, try things, and come back with something useful.

 Prior experience is not a requirement.

**Not for you if:** 




  





 This probably isn't for you if you're looking for:

**Details** 




**Duration:** 
 6 months minimum
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Work mode:** 
 Full\-time, in\-office
 



**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible

 Students can apply, but you should be able to commit to the role full\-time for the entire 6 months. This isn't suitable if you have significant college attendance or coursework running in parallel.

title: Solutions Engineer - Sr Staff, DFT/ Design for Test
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Applications Engineer, DFT
* Product Specialist, Design for Test
* Customer Solutions Engineer, Semiconductor DFT
* Technical Solutions Engineer, TestMAX
* DFT Tools Engineer


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You have spent years deep in semiconductor design, and you know that getting a chip to tape\-out is only half the story. The other half is making sure it can actually be tested at scale, in volume, without blowing up the schedule or the yield. You understand DFT not as a checkbox but as a discipline that makes or breaks manufacturability, and you have the hands\-on experience with scan insertion, ATPG, and tool flows to prove it.
   

  

 You are comfortable sitting across from a customer's design team, listening to their constraints, their timeline pressures, their tool frustrations, and walking out with a plan that turns those constraints into a working solution. You do not just demo tools, you configure them, script around their edges, and make them fit the problem. TCL, Python, Perl are not languages you look up, they are tools you reach for without thinking.
   

  

 You translate well. Between customer requirements and R\&D roadmaps. Between technical depth and executive summaries. Between what the tool can do today and what the customer needs by next quarter. At Synopsys, you will work on DFT solutions that shape how the industry builds and tests silicon, and the customers you support will remember the difference you made.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Work directly with semiconductor customers to understand their DFT challenges, design constraints, and tool flow requirements, then translate those into technical solutions using Synopsys DFT tools including TestMAX Manager
* Configure, customize, and deploy DFT tool flows tailored to customer designs, including scan insertion, ATPG, and verification using TestMAX ATPG, Formality, and VCS
* Deliver hands\-on technical demos and proof\-of\-concept implementations that show customers exactly how the toolset solves their specific design and test problems
* Script automation solutions in TCL, Python, or Perl to streamline customer workflows, improve tool adoption, and address gaps in existing flows
* Collaborate with Account teams to gather requirements, align on customer priorities, and provide regular technical updates throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Partner with R\&D to surface customer feedback, reproduce tool issues, and influence product roadmap decisions based on real\-world design challenges
* Stay current on DFT methodologies, semiconductor design trends, and emerging test strategies to ensure the solutions you deliver remain relevant and scalable


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Enable customers to achieve faster time\-to\-market by delivering DFT solutions that reduce design iterations and improve test coverage
* Increase adoption and satisfaction with Synopsys DFT tools by making them work seamlessly within customer design environments
* Strengthen customer relationships and retention by becoming the trusted technical advisor who understands their design challenges and delivers results
* Influence the direction of Synopsys DFT product development by bringing real customer requirements and pain points directly to R\&D
* Improve silicon yield and manufacturability across the industry by helping customers implement robust, scalable DFT methodologies
* Reduce customer support escalations by proactively solving tool flow issues and building automation that prevents common failure modes
* Protect and grow Synopsys' leadership position in semiconductor design by ensuring customers see measurable value from the toolset


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Master's degree (M.Tech or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* 8 to 12 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor design, DFT engineering, or related domains with direct exposure to VLSI design principles and design flows
* Deep working knowledge of Design for Testability methodologies, including scan insertion, ATPG, and DFT verification techniques
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as TCL, Python, or Perl for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Direct experience with semiconductor design tools and flows, exposure to TestMAX Manager, Formality, VCS, or TestMAX ATPG is a strong plus
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers, gather technical requirements, and deliver solutions that meet both technical and business objectives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of diagnosing complex tool or design issues and finding practical paths forward


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a messy design problem, and sketch out a tool flow solution on a whiteboard that makes sense to both the engineer and their manager
* You do not wait for perfect documentation or complete specs, you ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and move forward with what you have
* You are comfortable being the bridge between customer frustration and R\&D priorities, translating "this does not work" into reproducible cases and actionable feedback
* You stay curious about what is changing in DFT, test strategies, and semiconductor design, and you bring that knowledge into the solutions you build
* You follow through, when you commit to a customer deliverable or a timeline, you make it happen or communicate early when something shifts
* You are technical enough to debug a tool flow issue yourself and collaborative enough to know when to pull in the right expert from another team


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join a team of Product Engineers and Product Specialists focused on advancing semiconductor design methodologies and delivering measurable value to customers. This team works closely with Application Engineers and R\&D to ensure customer needs are met with solutions that are reliable, scalable, and grounded in real\-world design challenges. The work you do here protects Synopsys' reputation for excellence in the semiconductor industry and directly influences how customers experience and adopt our DFT toolset.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
   

  

 \#TPG

 Technical Asset Support (TAS) is a key enabler for the accelerated delivery of Shell’s Asset Management System and will help us to reach our ultimate potential in Downstream Manufacturing, Integrated Gas and Upstream. TAS provides high quality and cost\-competitive technical resources who are not physically present at site yet are an integral part of asset teams delivering value through end\-to\-end SEAM / AMS work processes.
   

  

 As an Associate Engineer \- Digital \& Drw Mgmt, you will support engineering document and drawing management in the energy industry by reviewing redline markups, updating and quality\-checking technical drawings and documents, and ensuring compliance with document control standards. It requires experience with AVEVA P\&ID, MicroStation, EDMS, and SharePoint, along with the ability to interpret P\&IDs, isometrics, and other engineering drawings, manage metadata, validate data quality, and support intelligent P\&ID conversion and maintenance activities.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Review red line markup (RLM) changes in technical drawings, collaborating with team members, incorporating revisions, and contributing to overall work quality. Work in EDMS (Doc Management tool).
* Proficient in interpreting and understanding corrections, redline markups, and updates across related engineering drawings.
* Proficient in AVEVA P\&ID as an end user with strong practical working experience.
* Ability to read, understand, and interpret P\&IDs, Isometrics, Plot Plans, and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Strong knowledge of AVEVA P\&ID application, including object attributes, relationships, and validation checks.
* Generate and analyze engineering reports, line lists, equipment lists, valve lists, and other project deliverables from the AVEVA P\&ID database.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve AVEVA P\&ID application issues related to drawing connectivity, database attributes, validation errors, and reporting inconsistencies.
* Experience in preparing engineering documentation, drawing evidence, and technical records to support Root Cause Analysis (Why\-Why Analysis) and incident investigations.
* Developed automated workflows and reports to enhance engineering productivity and data integrity.
* Experience working in critical assessment and quality review environments, ensuring high accuracy and compliance.
* Hands\-on experience in conversion projects from non\-intelligent (legacy) to intelligent P\&IDs, including data structuring and tagging.
* Ability to analyze, extract, and interpret reports generated from AVEVA P\&ID for quality control and data validation.
* Good understanding of engineering data consistency, tagging philosophy, and metadata management within P\&ID systems.
* Interpret and validate Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) based on process engineering principles, plant operations, and maintenance requirements.
* Identify discrepancies between P\&IDs, PFDs, Isometrics, Cause \& Effect diagrams, and other engineering documents.
* Perform engineering data validation to ensure compliance with asset tagging standards, drawing standards, and engineering best practices.
* Understand process flow, equipment functions, piping systems, control philosophy, and instrumentation represented in P\&IDs.
* Analyze the impact of proposed changes on equipment, piping systems, instrumentation, and associated engineering data.


**What You Bring**
* A graduate engineering degree with 3\+ years of relevant industry standard experience in combination of Process, mechanical, instrumentation \& electrical disciplines.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during peak workloads and provide flexible support across related processes within team scope.
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA P\&ID and MicroStation is mandatory.
* Performed data validation, consistency checks, and quality assurance of P\&ID deliverables.
* Support Team Leads with drawing\-related queries and technical support needs, including training site staff on software and request tools, and assisting with pilot tests and demonstrations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to deliver analytical solutions are essential.
* Strong stakeholder management and time management skills are required.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong learning agility and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication skills and a quick learner. Be a good team player. Ability to prioritize and ensure delivery of priorities for the area of responsibility. Flexible and adaptable to change, with a track record of demonstrating initiative, analytical capabilities and problem\-solving.
* Ability to apply engineering best practices, codes, and standards to identify issues, recommend improvements, and implement solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management with business interface exposure
* Strong interpersonal leadership skills are critical due to the requirement for effective communication of complex issues across multiple offices and teams.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects and programs simultaneously.
* Ability to independently, resourcefully, and creatively research and implement new solutions.
* Ability to engage and effectively communicate at all levels inside and outside Shell and within different cultural settings.
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to challenge and ability to build internal and external relationships based on trust and to integrate across multiple functions.
* Competitive applicants will have a proven track record of delivery in Asset and/or Project.
* While the hubs will remain the core locations for SEAM, we will continue to use a distributed working model. This means that our preference is to appoint the best candidate for the job on local terms working virtually from their base country.
* This role does not require global travel but may require flexibility in working hours to support collaboration across time zones, influence stakeholders, and drive business performance. Such flexibility will be considered with sensitivity to diverse family circumstances.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

 **Product Engineer \- Engineering Change Order Management (ECM)**

 **Manager**

* Work closely with IT for Design \& Engineering tools

title: Technical Procedure Writer
description:
For the past 25 years, ProPharma has improved the health and wellness of patients by providing advice and expertise that empowers biotech, med device, and pharmaceutical organizations of all sizes to confidently advance scientific breakthroughs and introduce new therapies. ProPharma partners with its clients through an advise\-build\-operate model across the complete product lifecycle. With deep domain expertise in regulatory sciences, clinical research solutions, quality \& compliance, pharmacovigilance, medical information, and R\&D technology, ProPharma offers an end\-to\-end suite of fully customizable consulting solutions that de\-risk and accelerate our partners’ most high\-profile drug and device programs.
   

  

 This Technical Procedure Writer position within Quality and Compliance is responsible for supporting clients’ development, updates, reviews, and approvals of Quality Documents, such as Policies, Procedures, and Work Instructions.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Manage the controlled document approval process (author, review, approval).
* Assist project teams in updating global and local controlled documents.
* Manage high volume of document updates from multiple regions and projects.
* Identify the procedures that need to be updated due to planned process changes.
* Coordinate procedure editing and review activities across global sites.
* Assist document authors with alternative wording, presentation, and style to ensure clarity of content.
* Assist project teams with harmonizing document update feedback from multiple reviewers.
* Edit draft procedural documents to ensure the technical material is clear, concise, and effective to global users.


**Necessary Skills And Abilities**
* 3\+ years of experience in technical writing, specializing in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions for the Pharmaceutical industry.
* 3\+ years of experience processing documents through the entire document life cycle, including Change Requests, red\-lining, stakeholder review, submission for approvals, and retirement
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience using electronic document management systems; Veeva experience is a plus.
* Highly proficient in MS Office products, such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
* Expertise in SOP writing techniques.
* Ability to work effectively with remote team members across different time zones.
* Able to work flexible hours when needed to accommodate global project teams.
* Able to work effectively with other professionals, such as Quality Assurance specialists, pharmacovigilance specialists, and information technology specialists.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to work on multiple simultaneous projects with tight deadlines.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.


**Educational Requirements**
* AS or BS degree in a related field.


**Experience Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience in technical writing, specializing in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions for the Pharmaceutical industry, including:
* Experience with the entire documentation development life cycle from procedure design, authoring, and approval workflow management.
* Basic knowledge of GMP, GCP, and GPvP processes is a plus.


 We celebrate our differences and strive to create a workplace where each person can be their authentic self. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. The Research group also provides data on hundreds of thousands of investment offerings, including stocks, mutual funds, and similar vehicles, along with real\-time global market data on millions of equities, indexes, futures, options, commodities, and precious metals, in addition to foreign exchange and Treasury markets. Morningstar DBRS is one of the largest independent sources of fund, equity, and credit data and research in the world, and our advocacy for investors’ interests is the foundation of our company.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 Morningstar DBRS’s structured credit research and ratings subsidiary, a Nationally Recognized Statistical Ratings Organization (NRSRO), is seeking an experienced editor to proofread, fact check, and polish complex financial reports for our investor clients. Our goal is to help investors evaluate structured finance investments, including commercial and residential mortgage\-backed securities, as well as asset\-backed securities. With Morningstar DBRS, structured finance investors have access to high\-quality ratings, investment research, surveillance services, data, and technology solutions. This position is based in our Mumbai, India, office.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Proofread and edit articles and monthly reports for accuracy, sentence structure, organization, grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
* Proofread, fact check, and edit presale reports for mortgage\-backed and asset\-backed securitizations.
* Ensure all reports adhere to Morningstar DBRS style standards.
* Work collaboratively to ensure high\-quality, error\-free content that achieves Morningstar DBRS’s mission to provide fundamental insight and analysis to help investors make decisions.
* Assist in other duties as needed, including editing marketing and compliance materials and correspondence with clients.


**Requirements**
* A bachelor’s degree in English, journalism, communications, or a related field.
* A minimum of four years of experience as a writer or editor with a credit\-ratings agency, general business and financial publication, or structured\-finance industry publication.
* Proven writing skills, including the ability to write a compelling lede, succinct conclusion, titles, headlines, and subheads.
* Ability to significantly rewrite copy to ensure organization is logical and easy to follow.
* Strong proofreading and editing skills as proven through the successful completion of Morningstar DBRS’s editing tests.
* Ability to do basic math calculations, including calculating percentages.
* Familiarity of Associated Press style and willingness to learn Morningstar DBRS style.
* Ability to handle multiple editing jobs simultaneously and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus.


 Submit writing samples, along with a resume/CV and cover letter. Applications submitted without all three items will not be considered.
   

  

**Morningstar DBRS is an equal opportunity employer.**
**About Us**
 Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world.
   

  

 Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much\-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech\-forward approach, and exceptional customer service.
   

  

 Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings.
   

  

 If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.
   

  

 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Associate - Technical Content | HigherEducation
description:
**upGrad Private Limited \- www.upgrad.com** 




  





**About Us \-** 




 upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry\-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital\-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.
 



  





**Designation** 
 – Associate \- Technical Content (HigherEducation)
 



**Work Location** 
 – Pune
 



**Work Mode** 
 – In\-Office
 



  





**Job Overview \-** 




 We are looking for a technically strong, deeply curious
 **Associate \- Technical Content Research \& Learning** 
 to work closely with the creator. This is not a traditional social\-media or YouTube\-operations role. The primary responsibility is to research technical topics deeply, identify what is worth teaching, and help convert complex engineering concepts into accurate, engaging, and pedagogically sound content. The role will span three areas:
 **Technical Content Research for YouTube, Content Strategy and Curriculum Planning** 
 , and designing the learning journey for learners who move from videos into structured courses on the LMS. The ideal candidate should have excellent hands\-on command of DSA, strong software\-engineering fundamentals, and the curiosity to independently understand unfamiliar systems and technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




**Technical Content Research \-** 



* Research DSA, software engineering, system design, backend, databases, distributed systems, AI engineering, and other relevant technology topics for upcoming videos.
* Go beyond surface\-level internet research: read documentation, engineering blogs, papers, codebases, interview discussions, benchmarks, and credible technical sources to build accurate context.
* Break down difficult concepts from first principles and identify the misconceptions, edge cases, examples, analogies, and practical insights that would make a topic genuinely useful to learners.
* Validate technical accuracy of ideas, examples, code snippets, diagrams, and claims before they are used in content.
* Build research briefs for each video containing the core question, audience confusion, key concepts, examples, counter\-intuitive insights, references, and recommended teaching flow.



  





**Content Strategy \& Ideation \-** 



* Identify high\-value topics based on learner problems, interview preparation needs, software\-engineering relevance, emerging technology shifts, and gaps in existing educational content.
* Help build weekly and monthly content calendars across DSA, System Design / Software Engineering, and AI Engineering.
* Study strong technology educators, creators, courses, communities, and content formats to understand what makes technical education clear, engaging, and differentiated.
* Work with the creator to turn research into strong video ideas, hooks, outlines, series, and long\-term content pillars without compromising technical depth.
* Use YouTube performance data and learner feedback to identify which topics, explanations, formats, and series should be expanded, changed, or discontinued.



  





**Learning Design \& LMS Pedagogy \-** 



* Design the learning journey for students who discover a topic on YouTube and continue learning it on the LMS.
* Convert broad topics into structured modules, lessons, prerequisites, practice exercises, checkpoints, assignments, projects, and revision paths.
* Design pedagogy that moves learners from intuition to understanding to implementation to practice, rather than simply organising a collection of videos.
* Create or review DSA problem sets, examples, coding exercises, concept checks, and assessments aligned with the learning objective of each module.
* Identify where learners are likely to struggle and design scaffolding, hints, worked examples, prerequisite refreshers, and progressive difficulty accordingly.
* Ensure continuity between free YouTube content and deeper LMS learning so that the transition feels natural and valuable.



  





**Collaboration \& Execution \-** 



* Work closely with the creator during ideation, research, outlining, and curriculum design.
* Coordinate with video editors, designers, platform teams, or other collaborators when technical context is needed for execution.
* Maintain organised research repositories, source lists, topic backlogs, curriculum documents, and content calendars.
* Stay consistently curious about new engineering ideas, tools, architectures, research, and discussions across the software industry.



  





**What We Are Looking For \-** 



* Excellent hands\-on understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms. You should be comfortable solving problems, explaining multiple approaches, analysing time and space complexity, and teaching the reasoning behind a solution.
* Strong computer\-science and software\-engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with areas such as operating systems, databases, networking, backend engineering, APIs, caching, concurrency, and distributed systems is highly desirable.
* Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technical topics independently and go deep enough to explain them accurately.
* Excellent research instincts: you should know how to distinguish a useful primary source from superficial or recycled content.
* Ability to simplify complex topics without oversimplifying or losing technical correctness.
* Strong written communication and structured thinking. You should be able to turn messy research into a clear learning narrative.
* Genuine interest in teaching and understanding how people learn technical subjects.
* High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort working in an environment where ideas are frequently challenged and improved.



  





**Preferred Background \-** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical ability.
* 0\-3 years of experience in software engineering, technical education, competitive programming, developer content, curriculum design, or a closely related field.
* Prior experience with LeetCode / interview\-style DSA, competitive programming, teaching, mentoring, technical blogging, open\-source work, or building software projects will be a strong advantage.
* Experience creating educational content is useful, but deep technical ability and research quality matter more than prior social\-media experience.



  





**This Role May Be a Great Fit If \-** 



* You enjoy spending an hour understanding why a system behaves a certain way rather than stopping at the first explanation you find.
* You can solve a DSA problem and are equally interested in explaining the thought process that leads to the solution.
* You routinely ask questions such as “why does this work?”, “when would this fail?”, “what changes at scale?”, and “how would I teach this to someone seeing it for the first time?”.
* You would enjoy helping build not just individual videos, but an entire technology\-learning ecosystem around a creator\-led channel.



  





**What Success Looks Like \-** 



* Consistently publishes technically accurate, differentiated, and well\-researched content.
* Video ideas are driven by real learner problems and strong technical insight rather than generic trend\-chasing.
* Learners can move naturally from a YouTube video into a structured LMS path that deepens their understanding and gives them meaningful practice.
* Research, curriculum, and content systems become repeatable enough for to scale without reducing quality.



  





**Why Join Us ?** 



* Help build a technology education brand from an early stage and directly influence what and how thousands of engineers learn.
* Work across content, engineering, research, and learning design rather than being restricted to a conventional content role.
* Get significant ownership over research, curriculum, and new learning formats.
* Work on topics across DSA, Software Engineering, System Design, and AI Engineering while continuously deepening your own technical understanding.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

**Experience**
* 6\-9 years of experience in corporate communications, business communications, communication consulting, content strategy, instructional content design, marketing communications, creative agencies or related fields.

* Experience working with cross\-functional or global stakeholders to deliver communication initiatives from concept through execution.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong storytelling, copywriting and content structuring capabilities.
* Ability to simplify complex business, technical or process information into engaging and audience\-friendly communication.

**Creative \& Information Design**

title: Assistant Solutions Owner
description:
**Job Description**
 We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Assistant Solutions Owner plays a key role within the Editorial Management Solutions (EMS) team, supporting the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions that power editorial and publishing workflows across Wiley's Research Publishing business.
   

  

 Working closely with Solutions Owners, Associate Directors, and subject matter experts, you will help gather and document business requirements, support testing and implementation activities, and contribute to the successful delivery of products, features, and services that meet customer and business needs.
   

  

 As an Assistant Solutions Owner, you will work at the intersection of technology, business processes, and scholarly publishing, helping ensure solutions are scalable, user\-focused, and aligned with business objectives. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop expertise in platform management, business analysis, and product delivery within a global environment.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Support the collection, review, and documentation of end\-user, business, and system requirements for products, features, and services.

* Support release planning, business\-led user acceptance testing (UAT), and solution rollouts.

* Track requirements, testing outcomes, project decisions, and timelines using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Aha.

**We power infinite possibilities.**
 For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
   

  

 We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
   

  

 Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

description:
**Job Title: Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation)**
**Location: Pune, India**

**Website: https://www.wmfts.com/en/**
**Group: https://www.spiraxgroup.com/**
 Watson\-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions is part of Spirax Group, a FTSE100 and FTSE4Good multi\-national industrial engineering Group with expertise in the control and management of steam, electric thermal solutions, peristaltic pumping and associated fluid technologies.
   

  

 When you join us, you will be integrated into a cooperative and encouraging team, participate in challenging yet critical work, and experience ongoing growth opportunities to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website to learn more.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a talented and motivated Application Engineer (Product Selection and Quotation) to join our dynamic team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**Project quotation and costing**
 You will prepare accurate quotations for engineered systems, equipment packages and project\-based enquiries.
   

  

 You will review customer specifications, drawings, P\&IDs, Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to determine the most suitable technical solution.
   

  

 You will prepare detailed cost estimates covering equipment, accessories, fabrication, testing, commissioning and logistics.
   

  

 You will work closely with our parent manufacturing factories to obtain pricing, lead times and technical clarifications.
   

  

 You will ensure quotations comply with pricing guidelines, margin expectations and approval processes.
   

  

**Technical support**
 You will provide pre\-sales technical support to Sales teams and Sector Managers throughout the quotation process.
   

  

 You will recommend technical solutions based on customer applications, process requirements and operating conditions.
   

  

 You will prepare technical bid documentation, compliance statements and product submissions.
   

  

 You will support customer discussions, both virtually and onsite where required, to clarify technical requirements and project scope.
   

  

**Project scoping and risk assessment**
 You will review customer requirements to establish project scope, assumptions and exclusions.
   

  

 You will assess technical, commercial and operational risks that may impact project delivery.
   

  

 You will highlight significant risks and recommend appropriate mitigation or escalation where required.
   

  

**Cross\-functional collaboration**
 You will collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support and local assembly teams to establish realistic manufacturing and delivery timelines.
   

  

 You will work with Product Specialists and Engineering teams on customised or non\-standard solutions.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary liaison with our parent manufacturing factories for technical enquiries, product selection and quotation support.
   

  

**Documentation and process management**
 You will ensure quotations comply with internal procedures, document control requirements and ISO 9001 quality standards.
   

  

 You will maintain quotation records, pricing information and standard quotation templates.
   

  

 You will monitor quotation progress, conversion rates and win/loss trends to support business reporting and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will contribute to improving quotation processes, templates, tools and costing methodologies.
   

  

**Project handover**
 You will prepare complete project handover documentation for confirmed orders, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), configurations, drawings, schedules and commercial information.
   

  

 You will work with internal stakeholders to support a smooth transition from quotation to order fulfilment and project execution.
   

  

**Continuous improvement**
 You will contribute to process improvement initiatives and support cross\-functional projects as required.
   

  

**Who you’ll be working with
   

  

 Internal stakeholders**
 You will work closely with Sales teams and Sector Managers to develop technical and commercially competitive proposals.
   

  

 You will collaborate with fellow Application Engineers within the regional Project Quotation Team.
   

  

 You will partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales Support, Product Specialists and local assembly teams to ensure successful project outcomes.
   

  

 You will liaise with our parent manufacturing factories on technical solutions, pricing and delivery commitments.
   

  

**External stakeholders**
 You will communicate with customers to clarify technical requirements, specifications and project scope throughout the quotation process.
   

  

**Skills \& Experience**
* 3\-5 years of experience preparing technical quotations, tenders or engineered proposals.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, datasheets and customer specifications.
* Sound understanding of mechanical or process engineering principles, including flow, pressure, materials and equipment selection.
* Experience with engineered equipment, rotating machinery, pumps, process systems or instrumentation will be an advantage.
* Experience using ERP, CRM or quotation management systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Maintain and manage databases related to quotations, orders, and project activities to ensure data accuracy and accessibility.
* Support vendor development activities for customized products such as SS trolleys, VFDs, motor covers, and other customer\-specific requirements.
* Calculate and analyse order margins during both pre\-order and post\-order stages to support commercial decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation initiatives using AI and digital tools to streamline existing processes, improve efficiency, and enhance overall productivity.
* Identify process gaps, analyse information, and proactively provide solutions to improve operational effectiveness and customer responsiveness.


**Qualifications**

description:
**About The Role**
 The Editor (AVSEC Focus) is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and editorial integrity of aviation security–relevant intelligence content produced across the MedAire and International SOS environment a 24/7 operational environment. The role plays a critical governance and quality control function in Aviation Security (AVSEC) alerting, ensuring alignment with MedAire Aviation Alert Reporting Thresholds and the AVSEC Alert Quick Reference Guide, and broader editorial standards. The Editor works in close alignment with International SOS analysts and editors and is expected to be technologically proficient with MedAire’s Content Management System (CMS). The Editor supports operational delivery by maintaining high editorial standards, ensuring outputs are clear, consistent, and actionable for operational and client use, and contributing to the continuous improvement of content quality across aviation security products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Edit and publish aviation security alerts, advisories, and assessments in line with AVSEC thresholds and editorial standards.
* Apply the AVSEC Alert Quick Reference Guide to ensure correct alert staging, formatting, and lifecycle continuity.
* Act as a quality gatekeeper for AVSEC content, preventing duplication or misclassification.
* Draft and edit short advisories for breaking aviation security events and ensure timely delivery to clients.
* Ensure consistency of aviation security outputs across service lines and alignment with MedAire standards
* Maintain alignment to a certain extent with International SOS editors and regional security teams.
* Maintain reporting discipline, including adherence to daily workflows, publishing timelines, and operational requirements
* Provide editorial feedback and support to Security Specialists and analysts, including structured feedback
* Support training and development of team members to improve content quality and reporting standards
* Respond to client queries related to aviation security content as required, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs
* Provide editorial oversight across multiple content formats, including written and multimedia deliverables
* Collaborate closely with global editorial, aviation, and regional security teams to ensure alignment and consistency.
* Apply sound editorial judgement to prioritise, escalate, and manage content during fast\-moving or high impact aviation security events.
* Builds strong working relationships across teams and regions; communicates proactively and supports collaboration in high\-pressure environments.
* Produces clear, concise, and well\-structured outputs tailored to operational and client needs; ensures consistency and quality of all content.
* Applies critical thinking and judgement to prioritise information and assess relevance during fast\-moving aviation security events.
* Uses CMS and operational tools effectively to manage and deliver aviation security content in line with required standards.


**CMS \& Technology Requirements**
* Strong working knowledge of MedAire’s CMS (Umbraco), or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to edit, preview, publish, update, and maintain aviation security content accurately.
* Adherence to CMS governance, alert lifecycle management, and quality assurance controls.
* High level of digital literacy and confidence working under time pressure.
* Confident use of digital tools in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive operational environment.


**About You**
**Required Skills and Knowledge:**
* High proficiency in copy\-editing and proof\-reading, particularly for time\-sensitive security content.
* Strong understanding of aviation security concepts including airspace, airports, operational risk and alerting discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear and actionable content.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical judgement.
* Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks in a 24/7 operational environment
* Advanced digital literacy, including content management systems and Microsoft Office tools
* Ability to collaborate across regions and functions, and cross\-functional teams.
* Integrated cultural sensitivity considerations into operations, communications, and client interactions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in journalism, international relations, security studies, or related field.
* International experience and multimedia exposure preferred.
* Additional training or certification in aviation security, intelligence, or risk analysis preferred.


**Required Languages**
* Fluent in English
* Additional languages are an advantage


**Travel / Rotation Requirements**
* Ability to work in a rotating shift pattern aligned with 24/7 operations, including weekends and public holidays
* Ability to support high\-tempo operational periods during global aviation security events


**Experience**
* Significant editorial experience, ideally in a news, intelligence, or current affairs environment.
* Experience working with breaking news or time\-sensitive alerting environments.
* Experience producing content for a professional or operational audience
* Exposure to global security issues, preferably related to aviation or geopolitical risk
* Experience using content management systems and structured reporting formats
* Experience contributing to quality improvement initiatives in content delivery

description:
**Health Policy \& Management — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 Your public health expertise is more valuable than ever — and not just in clinics or government offices. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, safer AI models. We're looking for Masters in Public Health (MPH) graduates to help ensure that AI systems provide accurate, evidence\-based health information grounded in scientific consensus and ethical guidelines.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your domain knowledge directly shapes how millions of people will interact with AI on critical health topics.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design Complex Health Scenarios — Develop advanced public health challenges covering disease outbreak simulations, health equity assessments, and statistical interpretation of clinical trial data
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step responses that synthesize peer\-reviewed research, epidemiological data, and authoritative guidelines from sources like the CDC and WHO
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated health advice and policy recommendations for factual accuracy, potential bias, and adherence to ethical standards — flagging misinformation and logical gaps
* Refine AI Reasoning — Provide structured feedback that helps models distinguish correlation from causation, communicate health risks clearly, and adapt messaging to diverse populations


**Who You Are**
* Holds a Masters in Public Health (MPH), MSPH, or closely related graduate degree
* Strong foundational knowledge in at least two of: Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Environmental Health, or Health Policy
* Able to translate complex health data into clear, culturally sensitive, and actionable written content
* Detail\-oriented when working with statistical significance, data citations, and intervention logic
* No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or research review workflows
* Proficiency with data analysis tools such as R, SAS, or Stata
* Background in health communication, clinical research coordination, or public health surveillance


**Why Join Us**
* Work on high\-impact AI projects with leading research labs and teams
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, 10–40 hours/week
* Freelance flexibility: high autonomy, global reach, and meaningful variety in your work
* Directly contribute to making AI safer and more accurate on topics that affect public health worldwide
* Strong potential for ongoing contract renewals as new projects launch

title: Digital Learning consultant
description:
**Job Description** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Way of Working Definition:** 
 Help translate our Project Management process into clearly defined ways of working, ensuring clarity on how ServiceNow SPM enables the execution of the process.
* **Training Content Creation:** 
 Design and build digital learning content to enable clear communication of expected ways of working to the ServiceNow SPM user community. This includes the primary user guide and other formats such as simulations, guided walkthroughs etc. This should be customized based on the user persona.
* **Digital Learning Experience \& Certification:** 
 Define and build structured paths, per persona, for the user community in Learning. This should ensure that they are confident in how they should utilize the tool and maximize use of key features. You will plan and execute a program of certification that enables a progressive learning path and assure user competence. Ensure accessibility, consistency, and compliance with Learning best practice.
* **Learning Governance \& Quality Management:** 
 Lead the creation and maintenance of learning governance. This should include the roles and responsibilities of all Triumph leaders and the publication of an end to end process that control how new content creation or change is triggered and managed ( new feature delivery, changes to way of working, response to user feedback etc ).
* **User Adoption / Satisfaction** 
 : Help drive user adoption of the tool by regularly engaging with the user community for their feedback and translating them into improved learning experiences.



  





**Key Interlocks:** 



* **Global Process Leadership (GPL) Teams:** 
 The GPL teams own their processes and are responsible for defining the overall, expected way of working in ServiceNow SPM. You will support them by translating this into appropriate training materials. Note: the GPLs delegate the
 
 detailed feature definition
 
 to the Epic Owners.
* **Triumph Epic Owners:** 
 The epic owners (also known as Workstream leaders) are responsible for specific elements of SPM functionality (Resource Management, Financial Management etc). They request new capability (including specification of features/user stories and UAT) and are responsible for their elements delivering business requirements. You will work closely with them on the details of the training materials.
* **Triumph Program Manager:** 
 The Program Manager will ensure that your work helps drives the expected capability improvements and business benefits. They will also ensure that all program resources are mobilized to work with you effectively.
* **ServiceNow SPM Product Manager:** 
 The Product Manager helps you to understand that "why" and "what" (strategy, use cases, roadmap), while you will define the "how" (effective learning methods, documentation) to ensure user adoption.
* **SPM Delivery Manager:** 
 The Delivery Manager controls the delivery of new tooling capability. You will work closely with them to understand what new features are being delivered and when, enabling you to plan and execute training content design and delivery.
* **SPM Support \& Communications Manager** 
 : You will coordinate with the Support \& Communications Manager in 2 ways. Firstly, they will help you to communicate with the user community in the most effective way and they will ensure you receive feedback from the user community based on support requests.
* **SPM User Adoption Manager:** 
 The User Adoption Manager is overall responsible for driving increases in user adoption and project quality. You will work hand in hand with them to ensure that the digital learning experience meets their needs and that feedback from the user community is funneled to you.



  





**Success Criteria:** 



* All training materials represent the current ways of working and are updated in line with each iteration release (where appropriate).
* Training materials are available in both English and French (note: French team members will provide the translation).
* New features are communicated and appropriate training delivered, minimizing business disruption.
* Increased user adoption and project quality (to be measured by User Adoption Manager).
* High user satisfaction scores in user surveys, relating to training content and delivery.
* Reduction in tool usage errors and support requests.
* High\-quality, engaging, and consistent training assets published Learning.
* 95% \+ of user community completing learning paths ( per persona ) and gaining SPM certification.

title: Consultant — Enterprise Change & Transformation
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
   

  

 At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
   

  

**We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.**
 The Enterprise Change \& Transformation Consultant builds organizations' capacity to change continuously — not just to land a single initiative. Rather than executing one\-off communication and training plans for a discrete rollout, this role helps clients stand up durable change capability: Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, and manager\-led change practices that make the organization resilient to constant transformation, well beyond any one project's go\-live date.
   

  

 Consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier, this role is the engine of an engagement: day\-to\-day contact for analyst\- and manager\-level client stakeholders, and owner of a discrete enterprise change and transformation deliverable or workstream. The Consultant structures sub\-problems, develops hypotheses, and produces client\-ready work with limited supervision, while beginning to informally coach Associates.
   

  

**What's New In This Role**
 From Project\-Based to Capability Building
   

  

 This role moves beyond writing communication plans and hosting training sessions for a single software rollout or restructure. The focus shifts to establishing internal Centers of Excellence, coaching line managers to lead their own teams through constant shifts, and creating scalable self\-service playbooks so the entire organization becomes resilient to ongoing transformation — not just the current project.
   

  

 From Activity Metrics to Value Realization
   

  

 Success is no longer measured by output metrics such as emails sent, town halls hosted, or training modules completed. The Consultant uses data and analytics to prove actual behavioral change, tracks real business outcomes, and measures value realization long after a project's go\-live date.
   

  

 Integration of Artificial Intelligence
   

  

 Rather than relying entirely on manual stakeholder mapping, generic templates, and human\-crafted messaging, the Consultant utilizes enterprise AI tools to draft communications, analyze employee feedback sentiment, map impact data rapidly, and scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Enterprise Change Capability \& Transformation
   

  

* Support the design and stand\-up of client Centers of Excellence (CoE) for change, including governance, playbooks, and role definitions that let the client sustain change practice after AHEAD's engagement ends.
* Coach line managers to lead their own teams through continuous, overlapping shifts, building manager\-led change capability rather than centralizing it with the project team.
* Develop scalable, self\-service change playbooks, toolkits, and templates that business units can apply independently to future transformations.
* Apply OCM theories and models, such as Prosci and ADKAR, to develop and conduct OCM assessments and plans, adapted for an enterprise, continuous\-change context rather than a single rollout.
* Analyze change impacts across processes, systems, culture, and people; identify affected stakeholders and understand their needs, concerns, and influence across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Support the development of digital transformation roadmaps and lead defined workstreams that translate business needs into actionable change, adoption, and implementation plans.
* Provide change management guidance to project teams and business partners, with an emphasis on building their independent change capability.


 Value Realization \& Outcome Measurement
   

  

* Design and track outcome\-based metrics — behavioral adoption, productivity, and business KPIs — rather than activity metrics such as communications sent or sessions hosted.
* Use data and analytics to demonstrate actual behavioral change resulting from transformation initiatives, and to identify where adoption is stalling.
* Establish stakeholder feedback mechanisms, analyze feedback, and recommend adjustments to the change management strategy based on evidence, not activity completion.
* Support the identification and tracking of KPIs, surveys, and reports that measure business value realization well beyond a project's go\-live date.
* Build basic financial and business\-case components (cost/benefit, ROI/TCO inputs) that tie change outcomes to the commercial story.


 AI\-Enabled Change Practice
   

  

* Utilize enterprise AI tools to draft stakeholder communications, accelerating and improving the quality of first\-draft messaging.
* Apply AI\-based sentiment analysis to employee feedback to surface adoption risk and stakeholder concerns faster than manual review allows.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to rapidly map change impact and stakeholder data across large or overlapping initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows (stakeholder mapping, reporting, content drafting) using enterprise AI tools, in place of fully manual methods.


 Engagement \& Practice Contribution
   

  

* Manage assigned deliverables and support enterprise change and digital transformation initiatives as part of larger project engagements, exercising judgment with appropriate oversight.
* Manage communication across multiple stakeholder groups, including senior leadership, and facilitate team meetings and presentations.
* Structure sub\-problems within a workstream into a clear analytical workplan, identifying the right analyses, inputs, and sequence of work, and explain to a Manager why the approach answers the client's question.
* Develop preliminary hypotheses with guidance from a Senior Consultant or Manager, design analyses that test them, and update the hypothesis when the data disagrees.
* Develop a working understanding of project economics on assigned engagements — billing rates, team composition, utilization targets, and margin structure.
* Informally coach Associates on the engagement, improving how they structure work, review output, and explain their thinking.
* Support at least one practice\-building initiative by producing reusable content (playbooks, frameworks, case studies) adopted by other teams.
* Own research and analysis for at least one thought\-leadership workstream, contributing analytical content to a published point of view or white paper.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities on current engagements and surface client needs to engagement leadership; contribute to 1–2 proposals or pursuits per year, owning sections of the response with guidance.


**Core Skills \& Capabilities**
* Strong understanding of change management fundamentals and enterprise change capability\-building, backed by at least 3 years of hands\-on OCM or transformation experience.
* Ability to design and stand up scalable change capability (Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, manager\-led practices) rather than only executing a project\-specific plan.
* Ability to define and track outcome\- and value\-based metrics, distinct from activity metrics, and to connect change adoption to business results.
* Working proficiency with enterprise AI tools for communications drafting, sentiment analysis, and impact/stakeholder mapping, applied with sound judgment.
* Proficiency in the Prosci ADKAR methodology, with the ability to apply Prosci tools and frameworks to assess change readiness, build change plans, and drive adoption.
* Strong project management, critical thinking, problem\-solving, data analysis, and information\-structuring skills.
* Ability to support digital transformation roadmapping and lead defined initiative workstreams in partnership with client stakeholders and project teams.
* Working knowledge of project economics — billing rates, utilization, and margin — sufficient to support scope and staffing conversations with engagement leadership.


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Client relationship management, including building trust, managing expectations, and serving as a credible advisor to business and IT stakeholders at the analyst and manager level.
* Business acumen, with the ability to understand client industries, operating models, and strategic priorities to frame recommendations in business terms.
* Executive presence and polished presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to senior leadership and diverse audiences.
* Analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable workstreams and defensible hypotheses.
* Effective time management and prioritization across multiple workstreams, deliverables, and competing deadlines in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Collaborative teaming skills, working effectively within cross\-functional project teams and adapting style to diverse team and client cultures.
* Informal coaching and feedback skills — makes junior team members better through the way work is structured, reviewed, and explained, without formal management authority.
* Proficiency with core consulting toolkits (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and enterprise AI tools to produce polished deliverables, executive\-ready presentations, and data\-driven analyses.
* Adaptability and sound judgment when navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving client needs across engagements.


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum 3 years of recent, relevant Organizational Change Management (OCM) or enterprise transformation experience, including supporting, driving, and facilitating change as part of a project or transformation; 5\-8 years of overall professional experience consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier.
* Demonstrated success delivering client services in a collaborative, dynamic, and fast\-paced environment.
* Previous experience supporting organizational change efforts of varying scale and complexity; experience building change capability (CoEs, playbooks, manager coaching) is a plus.
* Experience using data and analytics to measure adoption or business outcomes, beyond activity\-based reporting, is a plus.
* Familiarity or hands\-on experience with enterprise AI tools applied to communications, sentiment analysis, or stakeholder/impact mapping is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to own a discrete deliverable or workstream with limited supervision, and to informally coach or support junior team members.
* Prosci certification required.
* Willing and able to travel to client sites as needed for project delivery, approximately 25%.


**Growth Path**
 This role sits at the Consultant tier of AHEAD's Career GPS capability ladder. Growth into Senior Consultant is marked by leading multiple workstreams in parallel, shaping approach and workplans rather than executing tasks handed down, actively coaching juniors, owning client sub\-relationships, and
   

  

 proactively identifying and escalating delivery risks — increasingly applied to enterprise\-scale change capability rather than single\-project change management
   

  

**Why AHEAD**
 Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
   

  

 We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
   

  

**India Employment Benefits Include**
**Comprehensive health insurance** 
 coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
   

  

**Paid time off and company holidays** 
 , along with additional leave benefits as per policy
   

  

**Flexible work arrangements** 
 , supporting work\-life balance
   

  

**Learning and development opportunities** 
 to support continuous growth and upskilling
   

  

**Employee wellness initiatives** 
 and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being
   

  

**Retirement and statutory benefits** 
 in line with India regulations
   

  

**Inclusive and people\-first culture**

**Responsibilities**

* Designing and delivering training programmes and sessions.
* Facilitating the development of strategies and change plans.
* Supporting the design of operating models and organisational structures.
* Assisting with business process development.
* Planning and delivering change initiatives.

Each project offers unique challenges and the chance to deliver exceptional client experiences with a focus on sustainable results.
   

  

 Although geographically spread, we are a tightly connected team based in hubs across London, Manchester, Birmingham and India.

 What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

title: Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – Advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) Integration
description:
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
 



 Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI\-enabled state\-of\-the\-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high\-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
 



 Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission "To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust."
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are seeking an experienced Process Integration Development (PID) Engineer – MEOL/BEOL Integration for advanced CMOS technologies at 28nm and below, including FinFET nodes. This role is responsible for driving advanced CMOS Process Integration Development, with primary ownership of advanced interconnects (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, enabling technology development, device performance optimization, yield enhancement, and manufacturing readiness.
 



 The successful candidate will drive advanced MEOL/BEOL process integration while working across MEOL/BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, silicon characterization, DOE development, process optimization, technology qualification, technology transfer, and high\-volume manufacturing ramp. The role requires close collaboration with Process Module, Device, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
 



 At Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL), the Technology Development organization is responsible for developing, qualifying, and transferring various technology platforms from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing, enabling world\-class semiconductor technologies and manufacturing excellence.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration for advanced CMOS technologies (28nm and below), including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnects, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability to achieve target device performance, manufacturability, and reliability.
* Develop and optimize CMOS Process Integration technologies for 28nm and below technology nodes by driving process\-device interactions, DOE\-driven silicon learning, process characterization, and process window optimization.
* Analyze process integration trade\-offs using strong semiconductor device physics to optimize transistor characteristics, including Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, matching, variability, and reliability, while achieving target device performance and manufacturability.
* Support technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp activities, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Drive manufacturing excellence through defect reduction, process capability enhancement, process robustness, and yield ramp activities using SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, defect Pareto analysis, excursion investigations, and root\-cause analysis to improve process stability, device performance, and yield.
* Establish process\-to\-device and yield correlations through analysis of inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Utilize DOE, TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical analysis, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) to accelerate technology learning, process optimization, and yield enhancement. Experience with one or more of these tools is a plus.
* Collaborate with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive device characterization, reliability qualification, yield improvement, technology transfer, and production ramp.
* Provide technical expertise to solve complex process integration challenges while driving innovation, continuous improvement, and manufacturing excellence.



**Essential Attributes** 



* Strong expertise in advanced CMOS Process Integration for 28nm and below technology nodes, with solid understanding of MEOL and BEOL integration, process\-device interactions, and semiconductor manufacturing.
* Demonstrated expertise in advanced interconnect (MEOL/BEOL) process integration, including silicide formation, self\-aligned contacts (SAC), local interconnect integration, via integration, Cu dual\-damascene processing, low\-k dielectric integration, barrier/liner engineering, RC optimization, and interconnect reliability.
* Hands\-on experience in 28nm planar CMOS or more advanced logic technology nodes. Experience with FinFET technology, advanced interconnect integration, advanced patterning, and next\-generation device architectures is a plus.
* Strong semiconductor device physics foundation with the ability to optimize transistor performance parameters such as Vt, Id, Ioff, DIBL, SS, mobility, variability, matching, reliability, and manufacturability through process integration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven experience in DOE development, process characterization, statistical analysis, process window optimization, silicon learning, and root\-cause analysis of process, device, yield, and reliability issues.
* Proven experience in technology qualification, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp, enabling successful transition from R\&D into high\-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record in yield improvement, defect reduction, SPC, Cp/Cpk enhancement, excursion management, process robustness, and high\-volume manufacturing support for advanced semiconductor technologies.
* Ability to correlate inline metrology, WAT/PCM, electrical characterization, defectivity, physical analysis, reliability, and yield data to identify integration risks, process sensitivities, and process optimization opportunities.
* Experience with TCAD, JMP, Python, statistical tools, and advanced data analytics (AI/ML methodologies) is a plus.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with Device, Process Module, Yield, Reliability, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Strong communication, technical presentation, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical decision\-making in a fast\-paced semiconductor technology development environment.



**Qualifications** 



* M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 3\+ to 10 years of experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Semiconductor Engineering, or related field with 7\+ to 15 years of experience.
* Experience in 28nm planar CMOS, FinFET, or advanced logic technologies.
* Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics, process integration, DOE, statistical analysis, yield analysis, and process optimization.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
