This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.

What This Role Exists to Do  
Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.  
You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.

What You Will Own  
First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager  
Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing  
Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from  
Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction  
Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting

What You Will Not Own  
Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it  
Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing  
Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this  
SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it  
Campaign strategy or audience definition  
Client\-facing communications of any kind

Requirements  
Experience  
Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.  
Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.  
Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.  
Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.

Writing Ability  
Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.  
Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind  
Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism  
Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.

Mindset  
Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world  
Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing  
Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited  
Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have

What We Are Not Looking For  
Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently  
Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening  
Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability  
Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1  
Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample

title: Property Documentation Executive
description:
Property Documentation Executive

**Company:** Zorba Estates  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Experience:** 0–4 Years  
**Qualification:** Any Degree  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month

**About Zorba Estates**

Zorba Estates is a Bengaluru\-based real estate company providing professional property solutions to **buyers, sellers, property owners, and investors**.

We support clients throughout the property transaction process, including **property documentation, client onboarding, document verification, coordination, legal support, and transaction follow\-ups**.

Our goal is to provide clients with a **smooth, transparent, and professional real estate experience** through proper documentation, timely communication, and effective coordination.

**Job Overview :**

We are looking for a **Property Documentation Executive** to manage property\-related documentation, client onboarding, document collection, legal coordination, client communication, and transaction follow\-ups.

The candidate will coordinate with **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal professionals, and internal teams** to ensure that all required documentation and transaction activities are completed accurately and on time.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
**Property Documentation**

* Prepare and assist in drafting **Sale Deeds, Agreements, and other property\-related documents**.
* Collect and organize property documents from owners, sellers, and buyers.
* Check documents for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Coordinate with the legal team for document review and corrections.
* Maintain proper physical and digital records of property documents.

**Client Onboarding**

* Handle onboarding of **buyers, sellers, and property owners**.
* Collect required client and property information.
* Verify that the required documents have been submitted.
* Explain documentation requirements and next steps to clients.
* Maintain updated client and property records.

**Client Communication**

* Communicate with clients through **phone calls, WhatsApp, and email**.
* Provide updates regarding documentation and transaction status.
* Respond to client queries and coordinate with the appropriate team.
* Send professional emails requesting documents, approvals, signatures, and other requirements.

**Buyer, Seller \& Owner Coordination**

* Coordinate between **buyers, sellers, property owners, legal teams, and internal teams**.
* Follow up for pending documents, signatures, approvals, and information.
* Coordinate document sharing and other transaction\-related activities.
* Ensure smooth communication between all parties.

**Legal Documentation Support**

* Assist with preliminary checking of property documents.
* Coordinate with legal professionals for **property document verification**.
* Identify missing information or documentation and escalate issues to the concerned team.
* Assist in preparing documents required for property transactions.

**Follow\-Up \& Record Management**

* Maintain regular follow\-ups with clients and stakeholders.
* Track pending documentation and transaction activities.
* Update CRM, Excel, or internal systems regularly.
* Maintain confidential and organized records of client and property documents.
* Ensure assigned documentation activities are completed within timelines.

**Requirements**

* Any Degree.
* 0–4 years of experience in **property documentation, real estate operations, documentation, CRM, administration, or client coordination**.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Word, MS Excel, Email, and CRM**.
* Ability to handle confidential documents professionally.
* Knowledge of property documentation and real estate transactions will be an advantage.

**Freshers with good communication, documentation, and coordination skills are welcome to apply.**

Key Skills

**Property Documentation \| Sale Deed Drafting \| Agreement Drafting \| Document Verification \| Client Onboarding \| Legal Coordination \| Client Communication \| Email Communication \| Follow\-Up \| CRM \| MS Excel \| Real Estate Operations**

Why Join Zorba Estates?

* Practical exposure to **real estate transactions and property documentation**.
* Opportunity to work with buyers, sellers, property owners, and legal professionals.
* Learn real estate documentation and transaction processes.
* Develop professional skills in client coordination and operations.
* Career growth opportunities within Zorba Estates.

**Apply Now**

If you are **detail\-oriented, organized, good at communication and follow\-ups**, and interested in building a career in real estate documentation, apply for the **Property Documentation Executive** position at Zorba Estates.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

title: Junior Content Writer
description:
Introduction 
 We are looking for a Content Writer with exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong storytelling ability, and a deep sense of empathy.
You will work closely with the Sales/Operations Team to understand patient cases, medical conditions, treatment requirements, financial situations, and other relevant information, and convert these details into clear, emotionally engaging crowdfunding campaigns.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling sensitive medical stories and should be able to balance emotional storytelling with factual accuracy and responsible communication . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Write compelling, emotion-driven medical crowdfunding campaign stories based on information and case details provided by the Sales/Operations Team. Create high-quality long-form campaign content, typically 300500 words , that clearly communicates the patient's medical condition, treatment requirements, financial need, and urgency. Understand medical information and simplify complex medical conditions, procedures, and treatment details into content that is easy for donors to understand. Develop strong storytelling narratives that create empathy and encourage donors to support the campaign. Ensure all campaign content is factually accurate, grammatically correct, structured well, and aligned with the information provided by the Operations/Sales Team . Write content with an appropriate balance of emotion, urgency, credibility, and sensitivity , especially when dealing with critical illnesses and vulnerable families. Review and edit campaign stories for grammar, readability, tone, structure, and overall impact. Work closely with the Sales/Operations Team to clarify missing information and ensure campaign stories accurately represent the patient's situation. Manage multiple campaign stories simultaneously while meeting defined turnaround times and daily content targets. Adapt writing styles based on different patient cases, medical conditions, audiences, and fundraising requirements. 
 What You Bring to the Table 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong command of English. Strong storytelling ability and the ability to create emotionally engaging content. Ability to understand and simplify complex information, particularly medical and financial details. Strong attention to detail and commitment to factual accuracy. Ability to write clearly, concisely, and empathetically. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and manage multiple assignments simultaneously. Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification. English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media, or related backgrounds preferred. A highly motivated self-starter with a willingness to learn and take ownership. Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Operations, and other internal teams. Prior experience in content writing, storytelling, healthcare content, crowdfunding, journalism, or digital media will be an added advantage.

 7-8 years 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Planning and Documentation Engineer to support our interior fit-out projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining project schedules, creating and managing project documentation, and ensuring effective communication of project information across all stakeholders. This role requires a methodical and detail-oriented individual who can effectively manage the planning and documentation aspects of complex interior fitout projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills combined with excellent communication abilities to liaise with various project stakeholders. They should be able to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing project needs. A proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues through effective planning and documentation is essential for success in this position. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop, update, and maintain detailed project schedules using specialized software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) for interior fit-out projects. Create and manage project documentation systems, ensuring all documents are properly organized, version-controlled, and easily accessible to relevant team members. Coordinate with Senior project managers, site engineers, and other team members to gather and consolidate project information. Prepare and distribute regular project status reports, highlighting progress, milestones, and potential issues. Assist in the development of project execution plans, including work breakdown structures and resource allocation plans. Monitor project progress against the baseline schedule, identifying and reporting on potential delays or conflicts. Manage the RFI (Request for Information) process, ensuring timely responses and proper documentation. Oversee the submittal process, tracking approvals and maintaining an up-to-date log. Assist in change order management, documenting changes and their impact on project timelines and budgets. Prepare meeting minutes and action item lists for project meetings. Develop and maintain project dashboards and KPI reports for management review. Collaborate with the quality control team to ensure proper documentation of quality assurance processes. Support the closeout process by compiling and organizing all necessary project documentation. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field. 7-8 years of experience in planning and documentation for construction or interior fit-out projects. Proficiency in project management and scheduling software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project). Strong knowledge of construction documentation processes and best practices. Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. Experience with document control systems and processes. 
 
 Desired Skills 
 Familiarity with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and its applications in project planning. Knowledge of lean construction principles and their application to project scheduling. Experience with cloud-based project management and collaboration tools. Understanding of risk management and its integration into project planning. Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM) techniques. Knowledge of local building codes and regulations relevant to interior fitouts. Experience with data visualization tools for creating project dashboards. Understanding of LEED or other sustainable building certification documentation requirements. 
 
 Location 
 On-site -Pune, MH 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 48

As a Technical Writer, you will create clear, concise, and comprehensive high\-quality technical documentation for various products of Automation \& Communication Product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.

Do you enjoy writing and turning complex technical concepts into clear, structured documentation?


We are looking for a technical writer to join our User Documentation team in Bangalore. You will be part of a highly motivated, energetic, enthusiastic, collaborative, ever\-learning team who are proud of their work at Hitachi Energy.


You will be part of the team which creates and maintains technical documentation for various products of Automation \& Communication product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.

Your work will play a key role in making our technology accessible and usable for internal teams, customers, and partners worldwide.

Job Summary
  
  

* The Lending Documentation Coordinator position is primarily to support the various business units for the Non\-Standard Documentation and, where applicable, Standard Documentation process in accordance with the Credit Documentation Process \- General Roles and Responsibilities and any further guidance from the Global Head, LDU.
* It is a critical role in supporting multiple business units across Corporate, Commercial \& Institutional Banking and ensuring client delivery through management of the Non\-Standard and Standard Documentation processes. Working closely with the Regional Head LDU, this role oversees a broad, holistic perspective of transaction management challenges and requirements in the region.


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support the Regional Head LDU to set and implement the vision, strategy, direction for LDU regionally, consistent with the vision and strategy for LDU Global and in support of the Group's strategic direction and growth aspirations.
* Non\-Standard Documentation Process:
* Reviewing/checking bespoke / externally prepared loan documentation for complex, structured or syndicated transactions.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Working closely with internal legal counsel and engaging and liaising with external counsel where required.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required finance documentation, including Conditions Precedent, Conditions Subsequent and legal registrations perfection requirements, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.
* Standard Documentation Process:
* Drafting and negotiation of contractual, security and parental support documentation covering uncommitted and committed bilateral facilities in line with credit approvals.
* Drafting and negotiating local and global guarantees within Region and for the wider Bank network.
* Ensuring the financing structure and documentation is in compliance with the terms and spirit of the relevant credit approval and the Bank’s policies and procedures (including Operational Risk).
* Setting and collating all condition precedent/subsequent documentation.
* Engaging external counsel in relation to capacity and authority opinions and ensuring the review and sign of all legal opinions where required.
* Drafting corporate resolutions / reviewing constitutional documentation.
* Reviewing and confirming satisfaction of all required documentation, policy requirements and approvals via formal handover confirmation to the Credit Risk Control team for the authorisation of client limits.


Business
  
* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Single point of contact for any transactional escalations and remediation contact.
* Be a business partner to and independent guardian of the business, achieving the right balance.
* Utilise knowledge of business products and execution / funding processes undertaken in region to work with regional / cross\-regional business and functions to respond to transaction\-related questions.
* Work closely with stakeholders to ensure smooth integration of LDU processes with other processes of the Bank. In particular:
* Ensure that Legal and LDU work in an integrated fashion;
* Work closely with LDU in other regions to reduce duplicative work and ensure logical allocation of work (proposing exceptions to R\&R where necessary);
* Ensure that hand\-offs between Credit Risk Control and LDU are smooth and efficient;
* Resolve all roadblocks and any points requiring clarity, in collaborative fashion between LDU centres or between Legal and LDU or LDU and CRC.
* Adhere to LDU KPIs, ensuring that these are within thresholds.


Processes
  
* Identify process improvement initiatives / opportunities to drive efficiency across LDU.
* Implement and adhere to standardised operational excellence processes.
* Ensure completion of the LDU Data Activity Tracker in accurate and timely manner to facilitate preparation and management of Management Information including reports and dashboards.
* Support all control checks undertaken by LDU under the Operational Risk Framework (ORF).
* Ensure all LDU management information is updated/supplied promptly and accurately as required by the Regional/Global Heads, LDU.


Risk Management
  
* Mitigate possible risk and escalate to relevant stakeholders on potential identified risks.
* Ensure timely implementation and adherence to the Operational Risk Framework.
* Ensure Control Sample Test reviews are performed in a timely manner.
* Ensure all audit issues are handled in timely and appropriate manner.


Governance
  
* The maintenance of a robust control environment to ensure:
* The execution of documentation is approved by LDU in accordance with the Bank’s policies and the Credit Documentation Process \- General Roles and Responsibilities therefore ensuring the Bank is not exposed to unnecessary legal, commercial or regulatory risks.
* The timely processing of documentation and handover of condition precedent documentation to enable limit activation and collateral RWA to optimise revenue generation / return on tangible equity. Ensure the timely processing of any deferred conditions precedent / subsequent.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Client Businesses covered by LDU
* Relationship Managers
* Global Credit Markets
* Credit Risk Approvers / Analysts
* Client Managers
* Legal
* Credit Documentation Unit (CDU) / Credit Risk Control (CRC)
* Global Lending Services
* Stressed Assets Group


Skills and Experience
  
  

* Manage Conduct
* Manage Risk
* Manage People
* Products and Processes
* Bank Lending
* Business Partnering
* Process Management


Qualifications
  
  

* Degree in legal, finance or business administration studies
* Legal qualification or equivalent extensive work experience.
* Languages: English
* Relevant experience in a similar finance documentation and transaction management role in the relevant market enabling day\-to\-day responsibilities to be carried out with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-moving, demanding environment whilst maintaining high quality output, good analytical skills, risk\-based approach and excellent attention to detail. Strong organisational and prioritising skills are essential.
* Strong team player with excellent communication skills in order to effectively liaise with and develop close working relationships with stakeholders and business partners, across various jurisdictions.
* Good level of experience of international loan and security documentation (including LMA, LSTA, APLMA).
* Good level of knowledge of the Bank’s products (including Project \& Export Finance, Leveraged \& Acquisition Finance, Shipping, Subscription Finance, Commercial Real Estate) in relation to documentation.
* Detailed knowledge of the Bank’s relevant policies and procedures.
* Ability to quickly assimilate complex syndication and bilateral lending deals and product structures.
* Good knowledge of minimum acceptance criteria and collateral verification requirements.
* Good knowledge of the Bank’s standard template documentation.
* Good level of drafting and negotiation skills.


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  

**Together we:**  

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
  
What we offer
  
  

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  
Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
  
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Executive, E-Lab Documentation
description:
**About Apotex Inc.**
 Apotex is a Canadian\-based global health company. We improve everyday access to affordable, innovative medicines and health products for millions of people worldwide, with a broad portfolio of generic, biosimilar, innovative branded pharmaceuticals and consumer health products. Headquartered in Toronto, with regional offices globally, including in the United States, Mexico and India, we are the largest Canadian\-based pharmaceutical company and a health partner of choice for the Americas for pharmaceutical licensing and product acquisitions.
   

  

 For more information visit: www.apotex.com .
   

  

**Job Summary**
* The Executive is responsible for execution of LIMS change controls within Apotex Corporate structure.
* Maintenance of the Global laboratory documentation and data management systems, including the creation, revision of analytical test methods and In\-Process Manufacturing \& Packaging CofAs, LIMS CofAs and Test Profiles used in the testing \& release of commercial and R\&D products. LIMS static data for R\&D and commercial products, and the assessment of changes for impact to LIMS static data.
* Act as a technical resource and responsible to escalate any critical issues identified during implementation and review of change controls pertaining to LIMS static data changes.


 Responsible for product launch readiness and implementation of tech transfer packages for NPD, PLCM, MLCM and site transfers
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Create, revise and review specifications LIMS documents (CofA, Test Profiles)] and Analytical Test Methods for solid dosage, liquid dosage and raw material products in the corporate document management system in response to ongoing change control activities to support Global product transfers and apply harmonized testing policies for Apotex laboratories.
* Perform peer review of documentation and LIMS static data changes for accuracy and compliance with departmental, corporate and regulatory guidelines, and provide feedback as required.
* Issue document numbers for new specifications and analytical test methods.
* Route electronic documents through document management and laboratory information management systems to secure history
* Review new products and map testing requirements to existing analysis inventory list.
* Liaise with QC and R\&D labs, GIS, Global QC LIMS Business Support, Quality, internal \& external consultants on new developments \& cross\-divisional changes for configuration, code, reports and projects.
* Evaluate and initiate change controls in support of the creation/revision of specification documents, methods, LIMS master data and LIMS code/configuration.
* Update appropriate corporate document management and change control systems to reflect revision history for new \& revised lab documents
* Ensure the timely posting of LIMS CofAs and Test Profiles to the corporate document collections \& to external customers as required.
* Develop \& maintain expert working knowledge of LIMS functionality through on\-going project implementations.
* Coordinate tech transfers from R\&D to the commercial environment, including management of activities for the creation of Water\-mark and release commercial specifications.
* Ensure timely publishing of all specifications once regulatory NOC approval has been received.
* Perform all work in compliance with current SODs, GSOPs \& GMPs.
* Support LIMS projects and initiatives. Represent R\&D and QC LIMS static data/document configuration at cross\-functional LIMS meetings.
* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external customers.
* Manage hard copies of LIMS impact sheets, peer review forms and verification forms for timely storage and availability.
* Scheduling and monitoring of LIMS Review day to day activities.
* Work in a safe manner collaborating as a team member to achieve all outcomes.
* Demonstrate Behaviours that exhibit our organizational Values: Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance, and Passion.
* Ensure personal adherence with all compliance programs including the Global Business Ethics and Compliance Program, Global Quality policies and procedures, Safety and Environment policies, and HR policies.
* Create a culture which values trust and provides the opportunity for Employee development and growth in pursuit of our purpose and demonstrating our core Values – Collaboration, Courage, Perseverance and Passion.
* All other duties as assigned.


**Job Requirements** 
  

  

* Education
+ Master’s degree in Pharmacy

* Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
+ Experience with Microsoft Office applications. SAP, LIMS, TrackWise an added advantage.
+ Knowledge of GMPs governing documentation in the pharmaceutical industry.
+ SAP experiences an asset.
+ Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite applications.
+ Demonstrated leadership skills.
+ Demonstrated decision\-making ability with strong problem solving skills.

title: Consulting Sr Associate, Air quality
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 Our
 **Consulting Delivery Hub** 
 (CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high\-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
   

  

 As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
   

  

**Why this role matters?**
 As a
 **Consulting Senior Associate \- Air Quality** 
 , you will support ERM's North American Air Quality team by delivering high\-quality permitting, emissions inventory, and regulatory reporting services for industrial, energy, pharmaceutical, technology, and chemical sector clients. Working closely with ERM consultants, technical specialists, and client stakeholders across North America, you will help ensure regulatory compliance, data integrity, and timely delivery of regulator\-ready submissions. This role plays a key part in enabling scalable global project delivery by supporting complex environmental compliance programs with accurate technical analysis, streamlined documentation, and consistent quality standards.
   

  

**What your impact is?**
* Deliver accurate and regulator\-ready permitting and compliance documentation that supports clients in meeting federal, state, and local air quality requirements.
* Develop and maintain traceable emissions inventories, calculations, and reporting workpapers that improve data quality, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.
* Support the preparation of environmental submissions including Title V permits, NSR/PSD applications, Annual Emissions Statements, EPCRA Tier II, and TRI reports across multiple North American jurisdictions.
* Apply structured QA/QC processes to enhance data integrity, reduce compliance risks, and ensure consistency across client deliverables.
* Collaborate with global ERM teams, client stakeholders, and technical specialists to maintain project schedules, resolve data issues, and drive efficient delivery outcomes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, enhancing templates and SOPs, and supporting knowledge development across the Air Quality practice.


**What will you bring?**
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Science, or Chemistry, with coursework or exposure in air regulations, mass balance, or environmental data analysis.
* 1–3 years in NA air permitting or regulatory reporting with exposure to CAA, state permitting programs, and EPCRA Tier II/TRI reporting fundamentals; internships and co\-ops in industrial EHS or consulting.
* Emissions estimation, factor selection, and activity data QA in Excel, with strong attention to traceability and unit conversions per NA program needs.
* Working knowledge of Title V, NSR/PSD basics, NSPS/NESHAP applicability concepts, AERR inputs, and state annual emission statements.
* EPCRA Tier II/TRI fundamentals: chemical thresholding, mixtures, de minimis, SDS interpretation, and calculation documentation.
* Clear written communication for technical narratives and regulator\-ready submissions, responsive coordination with clients, regulators, and subcontractors in a remote delivery model supporting.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills \& Competencies**
* Experience supporting North American air permitting and regulatory reporting programs across multiple states or industries.
* Exposure to environmental compliance management systems such as Cority, ACTS, or similar platforms.
* Experience using Power BI, data visualization tools, or automation technologies to improve reporting and compliance workflows.
* Professional certifications, advanced coursework, or postgraduate qualifications related to Air Quality, Environmental Engineering, Environmental Science, or Sustainability.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Permitting support**
* Draft permit application content for Title V operating permits, state construction permits, and minor/major NSR/PSD, including process/equipment descriptions, emissions calculations, monitoring and recordkeeping plans, and applicability matrices referencing NSPS and NESHAP/MACT where relevant, ensuring state\-specific forms and attachments are complete and aligned with guidance such as NJDEP requirements where applicable.
* Coordinate inputs for dispersion modeling with senior modelers, prepare input data packages (stack parameters, release types), and maintain crosswalks linking model assumptions to application narratives and response\-to\-comment drafts for reviewer use, ensuring NA regulatory scope.
* Conduct desktop control\-technology research from public determinations and vendor literature to support preliminary BACT/LAER writeups for junior and senior reviewer refinement, keeping citations and change logs up to date per team SOPs.


**Regulatory reporting**
* Build traceable emissions inventories and reporting workpapers using client activity data, approved emission factors, and calculation templates, producing state annual emission statements, AERR inputs, Title V compliance/periodic reports, MACT/NESHAP periodic reports, and deviation logs as required for NA programs, with clear QA/QC checks and version control.
* Support EPCRA Tier II and TRI Form R/NA preparation by performing chemical thresholding, de minimis and mixture evaluations, SDS data extraction, and unit/stoichiometry conversions with senior oversight, documenting assumptions and data lineage clearly for audit readiness as emphasized by the SME JD.
* Reconcile permit, criteria/HAP, and GHG datasets to ensure consistency across submissions and client internal records, preparing evidence folders suitable for agency or client audits within NA jurisdictions, and flagging inconsistencies early for senior review and resolution.


**Quality and delivery**
* Execute structured QA/QC using checklist\-based reviews, cell protection, traceability notes, and exception flags in standardized Excel templates; maintain issue and action logs to track corrections and regulator comments, reflecting the SME’s discipline on data integrity and auditability.
* Maintain document control with consistent filenames, versioning, hyperlinks to source evidence, and regulator\-ready PDF packages with bookmarks and indices, supporting efficient review cycles with clients, regulators, and subcontractors per SME practice.
* Coordinate with client technical contacts, NA regulators when requested by senior staff, and subcontractors for data validation or specialized analyses; schedule and document communications and follow\-ups to maintain submission timelines


**Collaboration and learning**
* Participate in internal trainings on Title V, NSR/PSD, MACT/NESHAP, EPCRA Tier II/TRI, and state annual emissions statements; apply learning to improve calculations and templates, in line with SME guidance about the practice scale and expectations.
* Share lessons learned and template improvements with peers, contribute to frequently asked questions and SOP updates, and support onboarding for junior colleagues.

title: Electromagnetic Engineer - Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Application Engineer (Electric Motors)** 




**Company:** 
 Mecwin Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. 
 



**Work Location:** 
 Mecwin Corporate Office, Yeshwanthpur, Bengaluru 
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4 years 
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
 



  





**About Mecwin** 




 Mecwin Technologies is a Bengaluru\-based engineering and manufacturing company specialising in customised electric motors, powertrain solutions and advanced engineering products.
 



 Mecwin designs and manufactures AC Induction, BLDC, PMDC, PMSM, EESM and Axial Flux motors for applications across:
 


* Electric vehicles
* Aerospace and defence
* Industrial equipment
* Off\-highway and agricultural equipment
* Material\-handling systems
* Drones and eVTOL applications
* Automation and robotics
* Pumps and specialised OEM applications



 With an experienced in\-house engineering team and manufacturing facility in Bengaluru, Mecwin supports customers from concept and motor design through prototyping, validation and series production.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Mecwin is looking for an Application Engineer with strong technical knowledge of electric motors. The candidate will act as the technical bridge between customers and Mecwin’s Sales, Business Development, Design, NPD, Manufacturing, Quality and Testing teams.
 



 The Application Engineer will support the complete process—from understanding the customer’s application and preparing the technical solution to motor development, validation, customer approval and production handover.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Understand customer applications, operating conditions and technical requirements.
* Convert customer requirements into clear motor specifications and engineering inputs.
* Support the Sales and Business Development teams during customer enquiries, technical discussions and proposal preparation.
* Participate in motor selection, sizing, feasibility assessment and application engineering.
* Coordinate with the Design and NPD teams for customised motor design and development.
* Review parameters such as power, torque, speed, duty cycle, efficiency, thermal limits, voltage, current, IP protection, insulation class and environmental conditions.
* Support RFQ evaluation, technical feasibility studies, BOM preparation, costing and project timeline estimation.
* Prepare technical proposals, datasheets, product specifications, drawings, test plans, compliance documents and technical presentations.
* Possess strong knowledge in at least one of the following motor technologies:
* AC Induction Motors (ACIM)
* BLDC Motors
* PMDC Motors
* PMSM Motors
* Axial Flux Motors
* Understand the complete motor manufacturing process, including winding, stator and rotor manufacturing, insulation, magnet assembly, machining, balancing, motor assembly and final testing.
* Participate in prototype development, testing, validation and performance improvement.
* Analyse test results and coordinate corrective actions for technical or performance deviations.
* Support root\-cause analysis and resolution of motor failures, field issues and customer complaints.
* Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Purchase and Supplier Development teams to ensure product manufacturability and quality.
* Support product industrialisation and smooth transfer from prototype to series production.
* Understand relevant certification and compliance requirements, including BIS, IS, IEC, UL, CE and ATEX.
* Handle customer technical visits, design reviews, factory visits, audits and pre\-dispatch inspections at Mecwin.
* Travel to customer locations and manufacturing plants to study applications and understand installation conditions.
* Support the business team throughout the customer journey—from enquiry and development to testing, approval and production.
* Maintain technical records, revision controls, meeting minutes, action trackers and project documentation.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between the customer and internal teams.
* Provide post\-development technical support during product trials, installation and initial field performance.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* Sound understanding of electric motor design, development and application engineering.
* Knowledge of electromagnetic, mechanical and thermal aspects of motors.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and customer technical documents.
* Knowledge of motor performance testing, validation methods and test equipment.
* Understanding of motor control systems, drives and controllers will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with CAD, motor\-design or engineering\-analysis software will be preferred.
* Knowledge of DFMEA, PFMEA, DVP\&R, APQP and PPAP will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of quality systems and structured problem\-solving methods such as 8D and root\-cause analysis is desirable.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident in presenting technical solutions to customers and internal teams.
* Strong coordination, documentation and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Customer\-focused, responsible and result\-oriented.
* Able to manage multiple development projects and priorities.
* Willing to travel across India as required.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving engineering and manufacturing environment.
* Capable of taking ownership of technical activities and meeting committed timelines.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn new motor technologies and applications.



  





**Why Join Mecwin?** 



* Work on multiple electric motor technologies under one organisation.
* Gain exposure to customised and next\-generation motor\-development projects.
* Work on applications across EV, aerospace, defence, industrial, agricultural, automation, robotics and off\-highway sectors.
* Participate in the complete product\-development cycle—from customer requirement to series production.
* Work closely with experienced motor designers, NPD engineers, manufacturing specialists and business leaders.
* Directly interact with OEM customers and understand real\-world engineering applications.
* Gain practical exposure to motor design, manufacturing, testing, validation and certification.
* Opportunity to work on import\-substitution and “Made in India” engineering programmes.
* Strong learning environment with opportunities for technical and professional growth.
* Opportunity to take ownership, contribute ideas and grow with Mecwin as the company expands in India and global markets.
* Performance\-based career growth and opportunities to take up larger technical and customer\-facing responsibilities.



  





**Key Objective** 




 To provide complete technical support to customers and Mecwin’s business teams, ensuring that every motor requirement is correctly understood, engineered, validated and successfully transferred into series production.

 **listen to raw audio from scratch**

 **We rely on skilled human ears, strict style\-guide adherence, and manual proofreading rather than AI/automated draft editing.**

**Must Have**

 **sharp ear for difficult audio** 
 .
* **Manual Transcription \& Proofreading Background:** 
 Hands\-on experience doing

 Business Process Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyze and design new business processes to create the documentation that guides the implementation of new processes and technologies. Partner with the business to define product requirements and use cases to meet process and functional requirements. Participate in user and task analysis to represent business needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Computer System Validation (CSV)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 7\.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 In the role of Business Process Architect, a typical day involves thoroughly analyzing existing business workflows and designing innovative processes that align with organizational goals. This position requires creating detailed documentation that serves as a blueprint for implementing new processes and technologies. The role includes close collaboration with various business units to understand their needs and translate them into clear product requirements and use cases. Additionally, the Business Process Architect actively participates in user and task analysis to ensure that the solutions developed accurately reflect the operational demands and enhance overall efficiency.

* Responsible for team decisions.

* Lead the development and refinement of business process models to support strategic initiatives.
* Facilitate communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
* Mentor junior team members by providing guidance and support in process design and documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and increase productivity.

* Excellent communication abilities to effectively convey technical and business concepts to diverse audiences.
* Experience in documenting detailed business process workflows and functional requirements.
* Ability to collaborate across multiple teams and manage stakeholder expectations.

* The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in Computer System Validation (CSV).

* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - PMAX
description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support \[across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
   

  

 In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Technical Product Consultant will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
****Position Responsibilities** 
**:****
* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high\-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root\-cause analysis to implement long\-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end\-to\-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison \& Bug Management: Own the end\-to\-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high\-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co\-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep\-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train\-the\-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI \& Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI\-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data\-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.


**Required Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client\-facing role.
* 4\+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end\-to\-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real\-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer\-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products \[Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.


**Benefits**
* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

 The Training Associate is part of a global function called Operations and Processes – Training and Communications. This is a global role that supports training delivery to over 2000 Research \& Development (R\&D) employees across Haleon’s R\&D organisation.

* Partner with the Process, Standards \& Documentation team to support the development and delivery of learning that enable business readiness and effective adoption.
* Subject matter expert for training processing and applications, providing support to colleagues as needed.

 2026\-10\-08

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
 TartanHQ builds
 **HyperSync** 
 (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and
 **HyperVerify** 
 (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).
   

  

 We're hiring three
 **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** 
 to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.
   

  

 This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:
   

  

* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


 You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.
   

  

**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
- Deal Cycle Turnaround: Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination

- InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround: Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt

 Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time: \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/EngineeringClient Response Time: \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
 - Internal SLA Adherence: 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines

- Active Relationships Managed: Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads

- Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)
* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold
* Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)
* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients
* Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)
* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders
* Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)
* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required


**What We Look For**
* Client\-first mindset: Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* Ownership mentality: Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* Professional \& sincere: Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* Coordination discipline: Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* Composure under pressure: Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* Growth mindset: This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Company:** 
 Mactores
   

  

**Website:** 
 Visit Website

 Startup

 Service

 B2B

 Pre\-seed

 Information Technology
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹ 8\-15 Lacs PA
   

  

**Job Description**
**Mactores** 
 is the agent\-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward\-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
   

  

 As a Partner Solutions Architect, you own that documentation across all of our partnerships, not just AWS. You're given project and architecture details by the delivery team, and you turn them into the competency documentation each partner program requires, and into case studies you can explain and defend to a partner reviewer, to a prospect, to anyone asking "what did Mactores actually ship here."
   

  

 AI tools are fair game for drafting; the bar is on accuracy and whether it holds up under questioning. Do this well, and the natural next step is a presales architect role, taking these case studies and this partner fluency directly into prospect conversations.
   

  

**What you’ll do?**
* Create and maintain competency documentation across all of Mactores' partnerships AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI using project and architecture details provided by the delivery team.
* Produce the technical validation write\-ups, architecture diagrams, and case study documentation each partner's competency and service delivery program requires.
* Build a working command of Mactores' case studies well enough to explain them clearly the problem, the architecture, the outcome to partner reviewers, prospects, or internal stakeholders.
* Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, while owning the accuracy and review\-readiness of the final document.
* Keep documentation format and quality consistent across partners and engagements.
* Flag gaps in the project details you're given when they're not sufficient to produce audit\-ready documentation.
* Work against fixed deadlines tied to partner program renewal and review cycles.


**What we’re looking for?**
* 2–3 years of experience in technical documentation, solutions architecture, or a related role touching AWS and/or modern data/AI platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Anthropic, OpenAI).
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture concepts enough to read a design across different platforms and document it accurately.
* Strong technical writing skills; comfortable turning raw project detail into a document that reads cleanly to an external reviewer.
* Comfortable explaining technical case studies out loud, not just writing them this role grows toward customer\-facing work.
* Familiarity with diagramming tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar) for architecture diagrams.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of a documentation workflow, without leaning on them for accuracy you haven't verified.
* Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to hold a deadline without supervision.

title: Biochemistry Subject Matter Expert - AI Content Specialist
description:
**Biochemistry Subject Matter Expert (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, more scientifically rigorous AI models — and we need expert biochemists to make it happen. Your deep knowledge of molecular biology, enzyme kinetics, and metabolic systems will directly shape how AI reasons through complex life science problems.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed to fit around your existing commitments. No prior AI experience is required — just your scientific expertise.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced biochemistry questions spanning protein folding, nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, metabolic flux, and drug\-target interactions to rigorously test AI performance
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write precise, step\-by\-step technical responses that serve as benchmarks for high\-level scientific reasoning in AI systems
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and quantitative proofs for scientific accuracy and adherence to established standards
* Identify Reasoning Failures — Spot logical errors in AI reasoning — such as incorrect stoichiometry, misapplied stereochemistry, or flawed mechanistic logic — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance
* Work Independently — Complete task\-based assignments asynchronously, on a schedule that works for you


**Who You Are**
* PhD\-level expertise in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline (completed or in final stages)
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more core areas: structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, bioinformatics, or molecular genetics
* Ability to communicate complex biochemical and chemical concepts clearly and precisely in written form
* High attention to detail when reviewing chemical equations, molecular mechanisms, and experimental protocols
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote setting
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational biochemistry tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, curriculum development, or technical communication


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Gain firsthand exposure to how advanced large language models (LLMs) are trained and evaluated
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global network of domain experts
* Meaningful work — your contributions directly improve AI accuracy in scientific domains that matter
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Technical Trainer
description:
We are looking for a Construction Technology specialist with a keen inclination towards contributing and scaling up training and technical content for the internal Learning \& Development (L\&D) team. We are looking for a specialist with an expertise in Construction Technologies and BIM tools to design, develop, and deliver high\-quality training programs. The role focuses on enabling new joiners and existing teams to understand end\-to\-end construction processes, interpret construction drawings and effectively use BIM tools. We are looking for an individual who has strong background in construction technology and is keen and passionate about delivering learning content to ensure learner’s engagement and effectiveness in their roles.
 



 The candidate will collaborate closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), translate technical knowledge into structured learning content, and facilitate engaging training sessions with an eye on performing effectively, reducing errors, and supporting business objectives.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:**





* Assess training needs through surveys, interviews, and job analysis, SME meetings
* Develop customized materials and deliver in\-person training on technical topics related to the processes/ software/ tools used in construction management, such as:
* Construction Engineering, Design Coordination, Model Authoring, Shop drawings generation, Model based clash coordination, Quantification, 4D Sequencing, Procurement, Information Management, Project Controls etc.
* Application of VDC tools such as Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, Tekla, Bluebeam Revu, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.
* Work with SMEs to capture domain expertise and convert it into structured learning modules.
* Design and deliver in\-person/virtual technical training programs for a large group of employees
* Develop learning content like manuals, slide decks, e\-learning modules, and design interactive sessions
* Provide post\-training support and follow\-up to reinforce learning, application on projects and answer ongoing questions
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and revise content as needed
* Stay current with evolving technological trends in Construction Industry and update training offerings accordingly
* Track and report on learner progress and training outcomes



  





**Essential Skills \& Qualifications:**



* Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of construction technology/management field (etc.).
* Ability to read, interpret, and explain construction drawings (ASMEP) and related documents such as submittals, RFIs, PCI etc.
* Expert understanding of construction processes throughout various phases of construction (Bidding, pre\-construction, construction, closeout and handover) and interdependence within the processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with BIM Tools (Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, etc.)
* Instructional Skills: Ability to teach, present, facilitate, and adapt to different learning styles, translate technical concepts into user\-friendly instructions
* Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills to simplify complex subjects.
* Collaboration: Ability to collaborate and work effectively with a diverse group of SMEs, trainees
* Tools: Familiarity with modern training tools



  





**Experience:** 
 Min 4\+ years of experience on Construction Projects with a keen interest towards contributing to training initiatives and learning and development
 



  





**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree (master’s is preferred) in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management
 



  





**About Virtual Builder Group**




 The Virtual Builder Group works as an integrated partner with general contractors and subcontractors across the full construction lifecycle. The team supports bidding, preconstruction, execution, and closeout using well\-defined technology workflows.
 



 The group aims to make construction processes more efficient and predictable through consistent use of data and digital tools. The focus is on improving coordination, reducing rework, and strengthening decision\-making at every stage. Looking ahead, the team is committed to advancing automation and predictive analysis by using historical data. This mindset helps project teams move from reactive problem\-solving to proactive planning, resulting in better project outcomes.
 



  





**About vConstruct**




 We are a team of enthusiastic construction engineering and technology experts who are passionate about increasing the predictability of building better products by applying smarter processes while striving for faster delivery. We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large\-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.
 



 Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.
 



 We are a subsidiary of
 **DPR Construction** 
 , a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

title: Document Controller
description:
**Job Description**

title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems

As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research \& Technology (R\&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
   

  

 This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a
 **Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory \& OT Systems** 
 , you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
 **Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)** 
 .

They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R\&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R\&T process knowledge

 In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
   

  

**You Will Be Successful If You Can**
