title: Programme Associate-Technology Futures (Solar Manufacturing)
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose** 




 CEEW's Technology Futures team works towards mainstreaming appropriate global and indigenous technologies that can deliver energy security and sustainable economic growth at scale. The team's work spans clean energy technology manufacturing, critical minerals, and the evolving geopolitics and governance of clean energy technology collaboration, and has previously informed India's G20 presidency\-led work on global renewable energy supply chains.
 



 CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate to lead the Technology Futures team's technical research on solar manufacturing, covering the end\-to\-end value chain — from polysilicon and ingot/wafer production to cell and module manufacturing, and associated bill\-of\-materials (BOM) components. The candidate in this role will lead technological assessments of manufacturing processes, equipment and materials used across the value chain, while also tracking the policies, regulations, industrial strategies, technology partnerships, and geopolitics that shape solar manufacturing competitiveness across major global markets, including the US, EU, China, Southeast Asia, and India.
 



 The candidate will also evaluate emerging cell and module technologies (such as HJT, BC, and perovskite/tandem cells) and their manufacturing readiness, and guide the technical rigour of the team's research outputs. The role also involves tracking technology partnerships, licensing arrangements, and analysing how manufacturing incentives, trade measures, and geopolitical developments — such as export controls and trade disputes — shape the global solar manufacturing landscape.
 



 The candidate must have a strong technical/engineering background in solar PV manufacturing, along with the ability to engage with the policy, trade, and geopolitical dimensions of the sector. In addition to the duties and responsibilities outlined below, the candidate should be prepared, as and when necessary, to take on additional responsibilities and respond to ongoing events and developments in the sector.
 



 CEEW offers an intellectually challenging and conducive work environment, with a focus on research rigour, innovative thinking, and strategic outreach. We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented individual who would be excited to take research to action. We recommend that applicants visit the Technology Futures page for more details about our projects.
 



**Job duties and accountabilities** 




**Research and programme assistance** 



* Lead technical assessments of manufacturing processes, equipment and materials across the entire solar PV value chain — from polysilicon and ingot/wafer to cell and module manufacturing.
* Track industry technology roadmaps, such as the International Technology Roadmap for Photovoltaic (ITRPV), to anticipate shifts in dominant cell architectures and manufacturing processes. Based on this — evaluate emerging and next\-generation solar cell and module technologies, such as HJT, BC, and perovskite/tandem cells, and assess their manufacturing readiness levels (MRLs), which includes timelines to commercial\-scale manufacturing.
* Assess the timelines, capital costs, and production downtime associated with transitioning an existing manufacturing line from one cell technology to another (for instance, PERC to TOPCon), including equipment retrofit versus greenfield trade\-offs and yield ramp\-up curves, and track changes in bill\-of\-materials (BOM) and their cost implications.
* Map domestic and global supply chains for solar manufacturing inputs and equipment, including dependencies on critical minerals, and assess technology licensing and intellectual property considerations that shape manufacturers' adoption of new technologies.
* Track and analyse policy, regulatory, and geopolitical developments — including manufacturing incentive schemes, customs duties and trade measures, export controls, and technology partnerships between countries — across major solar manufacturing geographies, and assess their impact on manufacturing competitiveness.
* Use AI tools to accelerate literature review, data synthesis, and analysis of quantitative data, such as production capacities, investments, trade flows, and costs, enabling quick\-turnaround of research outputs for the team and stakeholders.
* Lead the drafting of high\-value technical research briefs and reports.



**Stakeholder engagement** 



* Engage extensively with equipment manufacturers, module, cell, and ingot/wafer producers, industry associations, government agencies, and international bodies to collect data, understand technical and policy priorities and challenges, and validate research findings.
* Track and build relationships around technology partnerships, joint ventures, and industry collaborations relevant to global solar manufacturing.
* Lead stakeholder consultations and workshops, and represent CEEW in relevant industry, technical, and policy forums.



**Selection Criteria** 




**Qualification** 



* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering — mechanical, materials science, chemical, or renewable energy — or a related technical discipline, with strong exposure to photovoltaic or semiconductor manufacturing.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant technical experience in solar PV manufacturing, technology assessment, or related industry/research roles.
* Hands\-on or professional experience with solar PV manufacturing processes, equipment, or engineering — for instance, with a manufacturing company, equipment provider, or technical research institution — is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with techno\-economic modelling, cost analysis, or manufacturing process simulation tools is preferred.
* Exposure to industrial or trade policy, geopolitics, or manufacturing/supply chain management relevant to clean energy — through coursework, prior roles, or otherwise — is highly desirable.
* Past experience working with secondary trade and investment datasets, such as UN Comtrade or WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), is an advantage.



**Skills** 



* Strong technical and engineering understanding of solar PV manufacturing processes, machinery and materials, and an ability to analyse policy, regulatory, and geopolitical developments and assess their implications for manufacturing competitiveness.
* Proficiency in tools such as techno\-economic analysis, multi\-criteria decision analysis, sensitivity analysis, decision trees, or Monte Carlo simulations is preferred.
* Familiarity with bottom\-up manufacturing cost models published by institutions such as NREL (National Renewable Energy Laboratory) and Fraunhofer ISE.
* Familiarity using AI tools, such as large language models and AI\-assisted research and analysis platforms, to speed up research workflows and produce quick, high\-quality outputs.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences, and present findings in a clear and accurate manner, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.



 CEEW operates in a dynamic environment, and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

 Our content is central to how we build trust with this audience. We publish advisory\-led video, written, and social content that helps buyers make better property decisions — not just promotional listings. We are looking for a Content Strategist to take this forward.
 




  




**The Role** 


 You will own the day\-to\-day creation of our content across video, written, and direct channels. This is a hands\-on role that combines writing, planning, and on\-ground video production.
 





 You will work with an established content system — documented frameworks, speaker voice guides, and researched topic and hook libraries — so you are not building from scratch. Over time, as you develop a feel for what works with our audience, you will take on greater ownership of the content direction itself.
 




  




**Key Responsibilities** 
* Write short\-form video scripts (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) for our on\-camera spokespeople, adapting to each speaker's distinct voice and style.
* Plan and execute on\-location video shoots — coordinating logistics, framing shots, and working with our editing team through to final output.
* Write long\-form content including blogs, locality guides, and platform answers that support our search visibility.
* Support the YouTube content pipeline — scripting, titles, descriptions, and publishing cadence.
* Write copy for email and WhatsApp campaigns used in client communication.
* Maintain the content calendar and report on output and performance on a weekly basis.
* Contribute ideas on topics, formats, and angles, and help refine our approach as you learn the market.



  




**What We're Looking For** 
* 1–3 years of experience in content writing, scriptwriting, or content production. Real estate experience is welcome but not required.
* Strong writing ability, particularly the skill of writing in someone else's voice rather than your own.
* Comfort with video production — you should be willing and able to be on shoots, operate a camera, and direct a shot.
* Consistency and reliability with deadlines. We value steady, dependable output.
* Genuine curiosity about the real estate market. The strongest people in this role develop real subject\-matter knowledge, not just content skills.
* Working knowledge of content performance basics and SEO fundamentals.



  




**What You'll Get** 
* A documented content system and clear frameworks to work within from day one.
* Direct exposure to the premium real estate market and the buyers, investors, and developers who move it.
* A clear path to greater strategic ownership as you build a track record.
* Close working relationship with the marketing leadership, with real input into how the function develops.





 ﻿
 




**Selection Process** 
1. Application and portfolio review — please share writing samples, ideally scripts or short\-form video work.
2. A short assignment reflecting the actual work of the role.
3. Final interview with the marketing team.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Why This Role Exists**




 The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.
 



**Responsibility and Focus Areas:** 




**Document \& Models Management** 
 – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.
 



**RFI Management** 
 – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.
 



**Submittal Management** 
 – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms
 



**Change Management** 
 – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.
 



**Construction Document \& Design Review** 
 – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.
 



**Model Based Coordination** 
 – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.
 



**Quality check** 
 models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.
 



 Use
 **Data Visualization** 
 means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.
 



**Process Improvement \& Innovation** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
 



 • Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
 



 • Document lessons learned and best practices.
 



**A day in this role** 




 The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.
 



**What You Should Bring** 




 · Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
 



 · 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
 



 · Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.
 



 · Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.
 



 · Strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
 



**About vConstruct:**

 We are a team of enthusiastic construction engineering and technology experts who are passionate about increasing the predictability of building better products by applying smarter processes while striving for faster delivery. We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large\-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.
 



 Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.
 



 We are a subsidiary of DPR Construction, a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

title: Principal Instructor
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
   

  

*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**What You'll Do**
* Deliver practical and theoretical technical training sessions, taking an active and responsive mentoring role in developing and disseminating knowledge to internal and external technical global audiences, which may include partners, customers, and end users.
* Build and maintain deep knowledge of the entire SOTI One Platform product portfolio, not limited to MobiControl and inclusive of other MDM/EMM platforms as applicable.
* Deliver exceptional presentations, using advanced communication and interpersonal skills, exhibiting a high degree of professionalism as a representative of Global Training and SOTI.
* Communicate with excellent command of the English language, in both writing and speech — this role regularly engages global stakeholders, produces documentation used across regions, and represents SOTI to international audiences, making clear, professional English communication essential, not optional.
* Consistently demonstrate a positive attitude to ensure high\-quality outputs, consistent delivery of commitments, and a rich learning experience for students.
* Demonstrate the technical fluency to clearly explain complex technical terminology; not just execute a process, but describe each step's purpose, what fails if it's skipped, and how to walk through it without reading from a script.
* Make sound decisions, remain agile and flexible, and exercise good judgment when circumstances don't go as expected.
* Maintain solid awareness of the different contractual relationships between partners and SOTI, and the limitations/operational parameters governing what can be shared with each partner, to protect confidentiality and integrity.
* Collaborate closely and proactively with Global Training team members — including regional peers and the India/APAC lead Principal Instructor — and take direction from the Manager of Principal Instructor Operations to create, manage, and deliver training plans for global and regional audiences.
* Demonstrate flexibility to travel extensively across India and the broader APAC region to deliver Instructor\-Led Training, and the ability to organize Web\-Based Training and self\-learning strategies where in\-person delivery isn't practical.
* Have flexibility with working hours, including starting later in the day where needed, to accommodate coordination and delivery across global time zones (APAC and EMEA) as required by the business.
* Oversee training quality for locations not visited in person, by building strong working relationships with in\-region personnel.
* Act as a lead facilitator for training initiatives, ensuring world\-class delivery and that the learner experience is never compromised — across a region spanning multiple languages, markets, and levels of technical maturity.
* Bring an audience\-focused facilitation approach, adapting delivery style and pacing to a wide range of technical backgrounds and English proficiency levels among learners.
* Actively apply a continuous improvement process to close the loop on feedback, addressing trainer issues and negative comments with a solutions\-first mindset.


**Impact and Contribution**
* The candidate's role will encompass individual managing contributions, setting and maintaining standards, and ensuring others adhere to Global Training's policies, processes, and procedures to be considered eligible to deliver training.
* Assess trainer readiness to deliver and facilitate training to a SOTI quality standard is critical to the credibility and overall success of our products and programs. Trainer authorization is a prerequisite to authenticating a SOTI trainer.
* Trainer to be certified on SOTI product certifications and other applicable certifications important to understanding MDM \& EMM environments and adjacent platforms.
* SOTI Certified Trainer certification is maintained and recertified every 2 years in keeping with Global Training's evolving training techniques and digital learning standards.


**Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Teams**
* Act as an SME for product knowledge intake, contributing solutions and assisting the Content Manager with deliverables and materials, aligning needs with Programs and Project training plans.
* Represent facilitation, working with product owners/managers to deliver training for new product introductions (NPI), including special events and training requests as supported by Global Training's business model/mandate.
* Communicate proactively and in writing on status, blockers, and process changes — this is a collaborative team, not a set of independent operators, and visibility across the group is expected as a standard, not an exception.


**Experience You'll Bring**
* Adult learning education background/post\-secondary education equivalency.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills — essential given the global, cross\-regional nature of this role.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across culturally and linguistically diverse audiences.
* Exceptional presentation skills, proficient in MS Office Suite.
* Very comfortable working, participating and communicating in a highly collaborative team environment.
* Proven partner relationship management experience.
* Strong knowledge and experience with MDM/EMM products and solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of emergent technologies, Windows Modern management, and Apple products.
* 3\-5 years of related work portfolio experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India and the broader APAC region.


 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

 VES is looking for a

**Job Description Summary**
 L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
   

  

 Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
   

  

 Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Ingénieurs responsables des activités de mise en service de la centrale, des spécifications et procédures de mise en service, des procédures de test hydraulique, du nettoyage des circuits, des procédures de mise en service du système, des procédures de test de fonctionnement ainsi que du programme et des plans de test de contrôle.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

**JOB OPPORTUNITY\|\| TECHNICAL CONTENT WRITER\|\| NOIDA**

Job Title: Technical Content Writer

**Location:** Noida (Work from Office)  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Seniority Level:** Junior

Role Overview

The Technical Content Writer will be responsible for creating high\-quality technical and marketing content across multiple channels, including blogs, case studies, website content, social media, email campaigns, and PR activities. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of technology topics and the ability to communicate them effectively to both technical and business audiences.

This role will work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Technical teams to develop impactful content around Microsoft technologies, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, AI, data analytics, DevOps, and managed services.

Key Responsibilities

* Create high\-quality technical and marketing content for blogs, website pages, case studies, whitepapers, solution briefs, and customer success stories.
* Develop content around Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, AI, cybersecurity, data analytics, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and managed services.
* Research complex technical topics and convert them into clear, engaging, and business\-focused content.
* Develop SEO\-optimized content to improve website visibility, organic traffic, and search rankings.
* Create and manage content for social media platforms, email campaigns, newsletters, and PR activities.
* Proofread, edit, and optimize content to ensure accuracy, consistency, readability, and brand alignment.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Technical Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to gather inputs and produce accurate content.
* Support marketing campaigns through content creation for landing pages, sales collateral, brochures, one\-pagers, and campaign assets.
* Ensure consistent IFI Techsolutions branding, messaging, and editorial standards across all content channels.
* Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and Microsoft ecosystem developments.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
* 1 to 3 years of experience in technical content writing, preferably in the IT, cloud, cybersecurity, or technology services industry.
* Strong understanding of B2B technology marketing and content development.

Required SkillsTechnical Skills

* Technical content writing and storytelling.
* SEO content writing and keyword optimization.
* Research and analytical skills.
* Editing, proofreading, and content quality assurance.
* Understanding of Microsoft technologies, Azure Cloud, AI, Cybersecurity, Data \& Analytics, DevOps, and Managed Services.

Soft Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and content accuracy.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Time management and deadline\-driven execution.
* Collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

Competencies

* Problem Solving
* Communication
* Collaboration
* Ownership
* Adaptability
* Innovation

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**  
A passionate technology writer with a strong command of English, excellent research capabilities, and the ability to create engaging content that bridges the gap between complex technology and business value.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Executive - Technical Services
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani** 
**Total Gas** 
**Limited (A** 
**TG** 
**L)** 
**:** 
 Adani Total Gas Limited is a prominent entity in India's energy sector, specializing in the distribution of natural gas. It operates as a joint venture between the Adani Group and TotalEnergies.
   

  

 ATGL is actively involved in the development of City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks, supplying Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to domestic, commercial, and industrial users, as well as Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) to the transport sector. The company has established CGD networks in various regions, including Ahmedabad and Vadodara in Gujarat, Faridabad in Haryana, and Khurja in Uttar Pradesh. Additionally, through a consortium with Indian Oil Corporation Ltd, ATGL is expanding its services to areas such as Allahabad, Chandigarh, Ernakulam, Panipat, Daman, Dharwad, and Udham Singh Nagar.
   

  

 In line with its commitment to sustainable energy solutions, ATGL has ventured into renewable energy initiatives. The company has established Adani TotalEnergies Biomass Limited (ATBL), a wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to the development of biogas activities in India.
   

  

 Through its comprehensive approach to energy distribution and sustainable practices, Adani Total Gas Limited continues to play a vital role in enhancing energy accessibility and contributing to India's infrastructure development.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 This role is responsible for assisting in drafting technical specifications for services and projects, supporting procurement processes and documentation, contributing to GIS management and value engineering tasks, providing administrative support for technology projects, and assisting in vendor engagement activities under the guidance of senior staff. Additionally, supporting the management of the Geographic Information System (GIS), contributing to identifying areas for efficiency improvements, assisting in technology project implementations, and helping maintain vendor relationships through communication and issue resolution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Services Trainee \- O2**
**Technical Specification Drafting**
* Assists in drafting technical specifications for services and projects under the guidance of senior staff, ensuring alignment with the business requirements of ATGL.
* Aids in the technical analysis process by collecting data to determine specifications for new projects.
* Contributes to the creation of technical documents and guides for internal use, ensuring consistency with company standards.


**Procurement Support And Documentation**
* Raises Purchase Requisitions according to the specified contract terms, facilitating the timely procurement of materials and services.
* Maintains and organizes documentation for all procurement activities, adhering to company protocols and procedures.
* Tracks the procurement process to ensure that orders and delivery timelines align with project schedules.
* Collaborates with procurement and finance departments to address any discrepancies in orders or billing.


**GIS Management And Value Engineering**
* Supports the management of the Geographic Information System (GIS) by performing data entry and validation tasks.
* Utilizes GIS to gather spatial data for project planning under the direction of senior staff.
* Engages in value engineering tasks by collecting data and preparing reports on service quality and cost management.
* Assists in identifying areas for efficiency improvements within technical service operations.
* Supports the modeling and simulation of pipeline networks by preparing data and running preliminary analyses.


**Technology Project Support**
* Contributes to identifying technological needs by researching and compiling information.
* Provides administrative support for pilot project implementations, including document management and reporting.
* Assists in the collection of data and feedback for the evaluation of pilot projects.
* Supports the transition of successful pilot projects to full\-scale deployment by preparing necessary documentation.
* Drafts the Technical Services newsletter for quarterly release and publication.


**Vendor Engagement Support**
* Supports the vendor evaluation process by organizing product samples and proposal information for review.
* Observes vendor negotiations to gain an understanding of procurement strategies and quality assurance practices.
* Tracks vendor performance against service level agreements and assists in reporting any issues to senior staff.
* Helps maintain vendor relationships by assisting in communication and issue resolution.


**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**
**Internal Stakeholders**
* Techno Commercial
* Human Resource
* O\&M
* Business Development Team
* Finance Department
* Project Management Office


**External Stakeholders**
* Consultants
* Technical Providers
* Vendors and Suppliers


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical Engineering, or related discipline.
   

  

**Work Experience**
 2\+ years of relevant experience in technical services, engineering design, or project support.
   

  

**Preferred Industry**
 Experience in the gas distribution, oil and gas, or energy sectors with exposure to engineering projects and technology implementation.

title: Software Support Engineer (Gujarati)
description:
**Job Title: Gujarati Language Specialist – End\-to\-End Bot Project (Client\-Facing)** 




**Department: Customer Success** 




**Employment Type: Part\-Time / Contractual** 




  





**About ORI:\-** 




 Have you ever heard of a humorless, boring bot that fails to reply beyond "Sorry I do not understand"?
 



 Yes, that's NOT what we are. (Thank God \& Gotcha!)
 



 Meet Ori, a self\-learning, intelligent conversationalist created by the visionaries at ORI, that improves conversions \& conversations for brands across industries. Our cognitive solutions are built and trained to revolutionize Sales, Marketing, Support, and Engagement across web, app, social media, and messaging platforms. Since 2017, we've been trusted and validated by industrial stalwarts like Tata Motors, Dish TV, Vodafone Idea, Lenskart.com, Royal Enfield, and IKEA. ORI's mantra is invoked through three golden words — "Speak your heart."
 



 We are looking for a native\-level Gujarati Language Specialist to join our team on a high\-impact, client\-facing conversational bot project.
 



  





**Role Overview:\-** 




 As a Gujarati Language Specialist, you will be the core linguistic anchor for an end\-to\-end conversational AI bot deployment. You will collaborate closely with internal product and engineering teams as well as enterprise clients to build, train, validate, and monitor high\-quality Gujarati conversational experiences.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:\-** 



* End\-to\-End Bot Support: Provide native linguistic expertise, conversational nuances, phrasing, and intent mapping during bot build, training, and development phases.
* Client Engagement: Attend active client meetings (\~2 hours daily) to understand linguistic requirements, capture conversational workflows, and deliver real\-time linguistic recommendations.
* Quality \& Auditing: Conduct post\-launch performance checks, chat transcript evaluations, and linguistic audits to maintain high response accuracy and relevance once the bot goes live.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration: Coordinate with conversation designers, bot trainers, and project leads to resolve linguistic bottlenecks and improve bot comprehension.



  





**Work Hours \& Capacity:\-** 



* Initial Ramp\-Up (Month 1\): \~6 hours/day during core development, bot training, and client integration.
* Post\-Launch / Steady State: \~4 hours/day for routine audits, performance reviews, and operational enhancements.



  





**Our Ideal Candidate Should Have:\-** 



* Language Proficiency: Native or near\-native fluency in Gujarati (Written \& Spoken) with a strong grasp of regional dialects, colloquial phrasing, and grammar.
* Communication: Professional fluency in English (both written and verbal) to facilitate smooth client interactions and internal documentation.
* Experience: Prior experience in localization, language quality auditing, bot training, content evaluation, or client\-facing operations (experience with conversational AI or chatbots is a strong plus).
* Attention to Detail: Proven ability to spot tonal inconsistencies, incorrect intent mappings, and grammatical issues in live conversational outputs.
* Availability: Ability to commit to dedicated part\-time windows (including scheduled daily client syncs).



  





**What You Can Expect from ORI:\-** 



* Passion \& happiness in the workplace with great people \& open culture with amazing growth opportunities.
* Direct exposure to cutting\-edge enterprise conversational AI workflows.
* An ecosystem where ownership is fostered and your inputs directly shape real\-world product interactions.

title: Script Writer
description:
**About Theory Labs** 




 Theory Labs is a video studio that solves brand communication problems. We make short\-form ads, SaaS explainer commercials, AI\-generated short films, launch trailers, and brand videos for clients across crypto, fintech, and SaaS. Small team, fast cycles, work that ships.
 



 The role
 



**You write the words behind everything we make. That means:** 



* Scripts for 15–90s short\-form ads, SaaS explainers, AI short films, and launch trailers
* Research before writing — the client's product, their competitors, their audience, and what's currently working on the platform the video is going to.
* Original concepts, not just execution of a brief. You bring angles the client didn't ask for
* Scripts written to our production constraints: shot count, AI generation limits, what the editor can actually build.
* Direct collaboration with the producer, editors, and clients — including live rewrites in review calls.
* Fast turnarounds. First drafts in 24–48 hours is normal here.



**What you need to be able to do** 




**Not credentials. These are the results:** 



* Write a hook that holds attention past three seconds, repeatedly, not by luck.
* Structure a 30\-second ad and a 5\-minute film with equal control — different tools, same discipline.
* Explain a complex product in one sentence a stranger understands.
* Shift voice between brands without every script sounding like you.
* Write to a visual constraint and know the difference between a line that reads well and a line that plays well on screen.
* Research a niche you know nothing about and sound credible in it by the next day.
* Kill your own lines when the edit says they don't work.

description:
Job Details Experience: 1-2 Years Location: Mohali Employment Type: Full-time Joining: Immediate or early joiners preferred Job Summary We are looking for a Junior Performance Marketer with hands-on experience in Meta Ads and Google Ads . This role is for someone who has already worked on live campaigns and understands how paid ads work beyond the learning stage. The person should be able to support and manage campaign execution, monitor performance, make optimization changes, coordinate with the internal team, and help improve campaign results across multiple client projects. This is a good role for someone who has 1-2 years of practical experience and wants to grow further in performance marketing by working on different types of client accounts, industries, budgets, and campaign goals. The selected candidate will work in a fast-paced agency environment , where multiple campaigns may be running on the same day across different clients. The person should be organized, alert, and comfortable handling regular campaign tasks without needing constant follow-ups. Key Responsibilities Work on paid ad campaigns for multiple client accounts. Manage campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads for lead generation, eCommerce, traffic, and conversion-focused goals. Set up campaigns with proper structure, targeting, budgets, creatives, ad copies, and tracking inputs. Monitor campaign performance regularly and make optimization changes based on data. Track key metrics such as leads, conversions, spends, CPL, CPC, CTR, ROAS, and overall campaign performance. Assist in auditing existing ad accounts and identifying gaps, issues, and improvement areas. Support campaign planning based on the client s business, budget, target audience, and objectives.
